Night Cityde neredeyse görebileceğim her şeyi gördüm, bütün sonlara gittim, yan görevlerin peşinden koştum ve farklı seçimlerin nereye çıktığını merak edip tekrar tekrar oynadım. Sonra bir de modlarla oynayıp oyunu iyice kendi kafama göre değiştirdim. Oyunun en sevdiğim tarafı kesinlikle Night Citynin kendisi. Şehir sadece görevden göreve giderken aradan geçtiğin bir yer gibi hissettirmiyor. Bazen hiçbir şey yapmadan arabaya binip sokaklarda dolaşmak bile yetiyor. Neon ışıklar, yağmur, radyolar, insanların konuşmaları, sokakta yaşanan küçük olaylar ve her yerde gördüğün farklı insanlar şehri gerçekten canlı hissettiriyor. Özellikle gece yağmur yağarken arabayla şehirde dolaşmanın bende ayrı bir yeri var. Bazen görev bile yapmadan yarım saat sadece şehirde gezdiğim oldu. Müzikler de bu atmosferin çok büyük bir parçası. Oyunun soundtracki ve radyolardaki parçalar hala ara sıra açıp dinlediğim şeyler. Bazı parçaları duyduğumda direkt Night City aklıma geliyor. Ana tema müzikleri, görevlerde çalan parçalar, boss karşılaşmalarındaki müzikler ve radyoların genel seçimi oyunun atmosferini inanılmaz tamamlıyor. Oyunu kapattıktan sonra bile bazı müzikleri dinlemeye devam ettiğim çok oldu.

Hikaye tarafında özellikle yan görevleri çok seviyorum. Ana hikayenin yanında bazı karakterlerin hikayeleri öyle güzel yazılmış ki ana görevlerden daha fazla aklımda kalan anlar oldu. Johnny Silverhand burada ayrı bir konu zaten. Başta sadece sürekli başına bela olan bir karakter gibi görünürken zamanla Vnin hikayesinin en önemli parçalarından birine dönüşüyor. Johnnynin sürekli bir anda ortaya çıkması, yorum yapması, olaylara kendi kafasına göre karışması ve V ile olan atışmaları oyuna çok farklı bir hava katıyor. Mizahı da çok hoşuma gidiyor. Bazen ciddi bir sahnenin ortasında Johnny gelip öyle bir şey söylüyor ki insanın bütün havası değişiyor. Keanu Reevesin performansı da karakteri akılda kalıcı yapan şeylerden biri bence. Panam, Judy, Kerry, River ve diğer karakterler de Vnin hikayesini sadece ana senaryodan ibaret olmaktan çıkarıyor. Özellikle bazı yan görevlerin sonunda karakterlerle kurduğun bağ ana hikayedeki bazı olaylardan daha fazla aklımda kaldı. Oyunun en güzel yaptığı şeylerden biri de Night Cityde yaşayan insanların sadece görev vermek için orada olmadığını hissettirmesi.

Rol yapma tarafına gelirsek burada oyunu biraz daha farklı görüyorum. Üst düzey bir RPG olduğunu söylemem ama kesinlikle zayıf da değil. Farklı seçimler yapmak ve farklı sonlara ulaşmak güzel ama bazı görevlerde keşke seçimlerimiz ve geliştirdiğimiz karakter daha fazla etkili olsaydı dediğim çok oldu. Özellikle bazı konuşmalarda sahip olduğun skill veya attribute yüksek olsa bile konuşmanın sonucunun pek değişmediği durumlar var. Bazı görevlerde belirli bir build yapmış olmanın veya belli bir özelliğe yatırım vermenin daha fazla karşılığını görmek isterdim. Yani oyun sana rol yapma özgürlüğü veriyor ama bunu her zaman sonuna kadar kullanmıyor. Buna rağmen build sistemi oyunu tekrar tekrar oynatıyor. Bir oyunda gizlilik ve quickhacklerle ilerlerken başka bir oyunda katanayla ortalığı dağıtmak, başka bir oyunda tabanca ve kritik vuruşlara ağırlık vermek baya farklı hissettirebiliyor. Aynı göreve farklı bir karakterle girince bile yaklaşımın değişiyor. Modlarla beraber bu tarafı benim için daha da genişledi. Bir noktadan sonra oyunu kendi istediğim Cyberpunk deneyimine çevirmeye başladım. Ama buglardan da bahsetmemek olmaz. Oyun bugün geldiği noktada eskisine göre çok daha iyi olsa da arada hala saç baş yolduran şeyler çıkabiliyor. Intercom açılmıyor, bir görevde olması gereken şey düzgün tetiklenmiyor, araba bir anda patlıyor, NPC veya araçlar spawnlanırken saçma sapan şeyler olabiliyor. Bazen de hiçbir anlamı olmayan küçük animasyon veya fizik hataları çıkıyor karşına. Özellikle yüzlerce saat oynayınca bunların hepsini görüyorsun. Bazıları komik oluyor ama bazıları da tam önemli bir görev sırasında çıkınca insanın bütün atmosferini bozuyor. Yine de oyunun bütün bu kusurlarına rağmen Night Citynin içine geri dönmek istemem benim için çok şey anlatıyor. Çünkü bir oyunda yüzlerce saat geçirip bütün sonları görüp yan görevleri bitirip farklı buildler deneyip üstüne modlarla tekrar oynadıktan sonra hala şehre dönmek istiyorsam orada gerçekten sevdiğim bir şey var demektir.

Phantom Liberty de bence oyunun en önemli parçalarından biri. DLCnin hikayesi, karakterleri ve özellikle Dogtownun atmosferi ana oyundan farklı bir tat veriyor. Daha kapalı ve daha yoğun bir bölgede geçmesi hoşuma gitti. Songbird, Reed ve diğer karakterlerle olan ilişkiler ve verdiğin kararların seni farklı noktalara götürmesi DLCyi sadece yeni görevler eklenmiş bir paket gibi hissettirmiyor. Hikayenin bazı yerlerinde gerçekten ne yapacağına karar vermekte zorlandığın anlar oluyor. Özellikle sonlara doğru olayların aldığı yön ve bazı seçimlerin sonuçları baya akılda kalıcı. Phantom Liberty aynı zamanda oyunun zaten güçlü olan atmosferini başka bir tarafa taşıyor. Dogtownun kendine has yapısı, karakterleri ve hikayesi Night Citynin geri kalanından ayrılıyor ama yine de oyunun dünyasına ait hissettiriyor. Ana oyunu seven biri için DLCnin hikayeye ve oynanışa yaptığı katkıyı görmezden gelmek mümkün değil.

Cyberpunk 2077 benim için kusursuz bir oyun değil. RPG tarafında daha fazla özgürlük verebilirdi, bazı seçimlerin etkisi daha büyük olabilirdi ve buglar hala zaman zaman karşıma çıkıyor. Ama bunların yanında Night City, karakterler, yan görevler, Johnny Silverhand, müzikler, atmosfer, build çeşitliliği ve farklı sonlar için tekrar oynama isteği o kadar güçlü ki bütün bunlar bir şekilde ağır basıyor.

遊びやすいが、人を選ぶ部分も多い。しかし素晴らしい作品だったと思います。そんな作品でした。

・バグについて

昔は酷かったらしいので、バグの存在が気になる方もいると思いますが、ここまで遊んで進行形の不具合は一度も起こっていません。しゃがんでいるはずの人が立ってしまっていたり…といった見た目の多少の問題がまだちょいちょいあります。が、起きるバグはすべてその程度。それも150時間遊んで10回もなかった程度です。

・アクション難易度について

難易度ですが、近接脳筋プレイでやっていましたが、FPSほぼ未経験の自分でも難易度はそこまで高くない感じでした。最初はハードで開始し、プレイ時間50を過ぎてからはベリーハード固定。それでも一番手こずったのはジャッキーと潜入するいちばん初期のクエスト（ハード）でした。それに比べれば、難しいとされているジョニーと二人だけでアラサカ陥落させる隠しルートのラストの戦闘（ベリーハード）のほうが遥かに楽です。

つまりこのゲームはアクションとしては序盤ほどきつく、その後はきちんとVを成長させていけばどんどん楽になるという仕様。序盤で詰まっている人はキツイのはそこだけなので諦めないで。総合的な難易度としては低めです。

・ストーリーについて

一つ一つのストーリーはハードで、救いがないものが多いです。常に何かを得るためには何かを失う必要がある。ナイトシティはそんな現実を突きつけてくる。一方でそんな世界を必死に生きるVの人生はまさに充実している。Vのハードな人生は顛末であるEDまで続きます。これが映画だったら苦しいだけの作品ですが、この作品の真の目的はそんな体験を通じて「人は何のためにどう生きるか」を問いかける事にあるようです。

素晴らしい話だった…と、思うかどうかは人によりけりですが、きっとあなたの記憶には深く刻まれる体験となるハズです。ぜひプレイしてみてください。

Cyberpunk 2077 çıkış gününde yaşanan rezaletten sonra ayağa kalkıp “ben buradayım” demeyi başaran nadir oyunlardan biri. Evet, ilk hâlini oynayan herkes travma yaşadı. Bug’lar, çökmeler, yarım hissi… Ama bugün geldiği noktaya bakınca şunu net söylüyorum: bu oyun artık bambaşka bir seviyede ve çıktığı hâliyle zerre alakası yok.

Şu an Cyberpunk 2077 inanılmaz derecede stabil. Bug neredeyse yok, performans tutarlı, sistemler çalışıyor. Oyun nihayet olması gereken hâline evrilmiş durumda. Ve en güzeli, bu sefer gerçekten oynadığını hissediyorsun; oyun seni yarıda bırakmıyor, sinir krizine sokmuyor. Yani evet, CDPR sıçtı ama sonra toparlayıp temizledi. Hakkını yemem.

Night City hâlâ sektördeki en iyi açık dünya şehirlerinden biri. Bu şehir sadece büyük değil, karakterli. Sokakta yürürken bile bir ağırlık var. Görsel tasarım, ışıklandırma, ses kullanımı… Hepsi seni içine çekiyor. Burası gezmelik bir harita değil, yaşanan bir yer. Oyunun atmosferi tek başına satıyor zaten.

Hikâye tarafı ise oyunun bel kemiği. V’nin yolculuğu, Johnny Silverhand ile olan çatışmalı ilişki, yan görevlerin beklenmedik derecede güçlü yazımı… Cyberpunk burada hiç şaka yapmıyor. Birçok yan görev ana hikâyeden daha etkili. Karakterler klişe değil, diyaloglar yapay durmuyor. Oyun sana duyguyu zorla dayatmıyor, yaşatıyor.

Oynanış da artık çok daha oturmuş durumda. Build çeşitliliği, silah hissi, siber yetenekler, stealth ve çatışma dengesi gayet sağlam. Eskiden “neden böyle” dediğin şeylerin çoğu ya düzeltilmiş ya da tamamen elden geçirilmiş. Şu hâliyle oyun akıyor, takılmadan oynatıyor ve tatmin ediyor.

Ve evet, şunu açık açık söyleyeyim: Ben bu oyunu gerçekten çok seviyorum. Sadece “düzeldiği için” değil, bugün sunduğu deneyim yüzünden. Cyberpunk 2077 şu an oynanması gereken, hatta kaçırılmaması gereken bir oyun. Çıkıştaki hâli yüzünden hâlâ önyargılı olanlar büyük resmi kaçırıyor.

Özetle:
Çıkışta rezalet.
Bugün tertemiz.
Atmosfer efsane.
Hikâye güçlü.
Oynanış nihayet oturmuş.

Cyberpunk 2077, sektörün en büyük geri dönüş hikâyelerinden biri. Baştan sıçıp sonra bu kadar sağlam toparlamak kolay iş değil. Bugün bu oyunu açıp keyif almıyorsan sorun oyunda değil, sende olabilir.

Cyberpunk is truly a once in a lifetime game. I didn't play it when it first came out, so I experienced the game as it is now. And holy shit it blew me away.

It's an absolutely gorgeous game, and the city feels alive. There are people everywhere, not just walking around but seemingly actually living their lives. I drive to every destination I have because I enjoy just existing within the city so much.

The story is amazing, the NPCs are memorable and deep, and even the side missions are amazing. They go from silly things like a man whose peepee is burning to genuine and unsettling injustices done against others that make you sit and think about how terrible people can be. It balances humor and dark themes effortlessly. I love this world so much. I avoided ending the game for maybe 30 hours or so just because I didn't want it to end, only to find out that the game is kind and allows you to keep playing even if you end it. The choices you face, especially at the end, feel heavy and hard. Even the happiest of endings feels bittersweet, and that's okay because the story is so good that it makes sense. It tackles its darkest themes with grace but without holding back. 

I also love that V really has a personality - you're controlling her, yes, and you do make decisions, but you're playing AS her. She's a deep character full of flaws and grit and hope and emotion. I love the NPCs who become her friends in the game too. 

I also just enjoyed the gameplay. Hacking is fun, sniping is fun, running and gunning is fun, throwing knives is FUN (my favorite playstyle personally). As you level up you slowly feel more powerful, but not so much so that you'd never struggle. Driving is fun with the right vehicles (the handling on some is rough, but once you find the right ones you're cruising). The amount of character customization is amazing too.

But at the core of it, Cyberpunk is just one of a kind. There's nothing like it. No other open-world game comes close to the depth of its world, the importance of its themes, its writing, its art. I've played so many single player games and none made me feel the way that Cyberpunk has. I would do anything to play this game again for the first time - I cannot recommend it enough.

There's no open world RPG game on the market that gives you what Cyberpunk 2077 does. You finish the game and realize there won't be a game to scratch that itch until Cyberpunk 2. Changes your perspective on RPGs in general. This is the industry standard.

Completing Cyberpunk was a powerful experience. I want to share my thoughts while the emotions are still fresh.
First of all, Night City is not just a set; it’s a living organism. And the characters make it live. Jackie Wells has become a real bro for me. His attachment to his mother and sincere love for Misty make his image human and worldly. His vitality, ambition and sincerity caught on without trying to appear as someone else. His loss is felt acutely, not just the death of a loyal friend, but the loss of a sense of security. The city suddenly becomes empty when the only person who believed in you without any hidden motives disappears.

Special thanks to the developers for Judy. Stunningly written character with a solid character, behind whose external harshness hides an aching soul. Her strong independence and anarchist spirit combine with an inability to cope with emotional problems and a tendency towards self-destruction. Despair, sabotage and emotional problems seem very real, not just a perfect option of romance, which makes her journey more impressive. Great empathy caused the similarity of this character with me, forcing to self-reflection. Not just an admiration for the character, but a chance to better understand yourself. It serves as a kind of mirror reflecting my inner conflicts, fears and desires. It shows that you can be both strong and vulnerable, idealistic and realistic, that you can fight injustice while seeking inner peace. Her story is a reminder that even in the darkest world you can find light and hope, and it’s normal to open, even if it’s scary.

The ending of Arasaka is remembered for a long time, dark and psychologically difficult. In exchange for the promise of life you give up your freedom and dignity. In this ending you understand that for Arasaka you are not a hero or even an ally, but a valuable asset or just a lab rat. Friends from a past life either distance themselves, or look at you with pity.
The space station scene where V endlessly solving the Rubik’s Cube is a brilliant way to convey mental decay. You repeat it again and again, but it does not bring satisfaction. It is a symbol that the V's mind is damaged, and Arasaka simply calibrates the remnants of your personality. When V in rage or despair disassembles the cube and finds a red devil inside, this is the moment of truth. It’s the realization that there is nothing human inside you anymore, only corporate code. You survived, but the price of this life was so high that life itself lost its meaning.

One of the drawbacks for me is the lack of a canonical end. I appreciate when there is a clear conclusion in the narrative, where everything is wrapped up and understood. Not when you have the option to select a favorable outcome for yourself. It's preferable to have one clear conclusion. Even if it leads to disappointment.

Je vais aller droit au but : vous devez jouer à ce jeu une fois dans votre vie. 
Pour éviter d'avoir de faux espoirs : lancez le jeu sans avoir d'attentes particulières et profitez de ce qu'il a à offrir. 
ATTENTION ! J'estime que c'est un jeu qui s'apparente plus à un film interactif plutôt qu'un énième jeu de tir banal. Je pense que le temps de jeu se décompose de la façon suivante : 75% dans des dialogues et cinématiques avec prises de décisions. 25% dans les combats, infiltrations et explorations.
Le doublage français est sublime, donc aucune raison de ne pas en profiter !
Je vous conseille même de jouer sans les sous-titres pour s'immerger au maximum dans l'univers et admirer le travail fait sur l'environnement, les personnages, les voix et les animations.

Si vous voulez plus de détails, vous pouvez lire les points suivants.

Les points que j'ai aimé :
- Des sujets importants, concrets (et ignobles) de notre société sont mis en lumières (des sujets plus légers et drôles sont aussi de la partie)
- L'ambiance cyberpunk et de Night City sont au rendez-vous jusque dans les moindres détails
- Le scénario est génial
- Une VF exceptionnelle
- La prise de décisions et l'impact de celles-ci se ressentent dans le jeu
- Les relations que l'on créé avec les différents personnages sont super
- Le gameplay est très bon et offre différents styles de combats (discrétion / hacking / armes à feu / armes au corps à corps...)
- Le système d'implants pour s'améliorer renforce l'immersion dans l'univers

Les points négatifs :
- Quelques bugs mineurs mais ils n'ont pas impactés mon expérience au global
- Il faut une bonne machine pour le faire tourner avec suffisamment de FPS et une excellente qualité graphique (notamment dans la zone du DLC)
- Par moment, j'ai eu la sensation que les animations labiales étaient moins bien travaillés dans les missions du DLC.

J'ai hâte de découvrir le prochain opus.

Cyberpunk 2077 is one of the best games that I’ve played. It had a rough start back in 2020, but they put the time and effort into fixing it up, and it is now one of the greatest story games I’ve ever played.

The story is massive and full of options, with multiple endings and dialogue choices. It’s an amazing game for people who like having choices that affect their experience.

The gameplay is also great. The gunplay feels really solid, and the same goes for the melee weapons. It never felt like a cheap game. Hacking while fighting also felt very fluid and easy, creating some really cool and cinematic moments.

The characters are well written. You genuinely feel for them and feel like you have real connections with them.

The graphics are some of the best out there, especially with ray tracing and path tracing. The soundtrack in this game is amazing. I’ve even saved a couple of tracks to my Spotify playlist.

The performance of the game varies depending on what you play it on, and it can be a bit demanding. For me, my PC ran it insanely well at 4K and 120 FPS.

The DLC is 100% worth purchasing.

Overall, this game is a 10/10 masterpiece, and it’s one of those games that I can always replay.

Cyberpunk 2077 é aquele jogo que teve um dos lançamentos mais caóticos da história… mas que, anos depois, conseguiu dar a volta por cima. Hoje ele está totalmente jogável e, sinceramente, virou um jogaço, com algumas pequenas ressalvas, claro.

A história é muito envolvente e cheia de escolhas ao longo da trama. Os personagens são muito bem construídos e as missões secundárias lembram bastante o nível de qualidade de The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Não é aquele tipo de side quest genérica só pra inflar mapa; várias são tão boas que você acaba fazendo todas sem perceber. Eu mesmo comecei pegando “só mais uma missão” e quando vi já tinha limpado metade do painel.

Também sou suspeito pra falar porque sou muito fã do gênero cyberpunk. Cresci consumindo coisas como Akira, Ghost in the Shell e Cowboy Bebop. Então jogar Cyberpunk 2077 foi quase como finalmente visitar um dos mundos que sempre imaginei. Night City é absurda de estilosa, decadente e cheia de personalidade.

E o jogo também manda várias cutucadas bem interessantes no capitalismo do futuro. Tipo anúncios de comida dizendo “70% carne de verdade!” (o que automaticamente levanta a pergunta: e os outros 30%?). Purificadores de ar viram item essencial porque o ar está basicamente impróprio para humanos, água mineral pura vira artigo de luxo para ricos e frutas frescas parecem coisa de museu. É aquele tipo de detalhe de worldbuilding que te faz rir… e depois pensar “pera aí, isso aqui não tá tão longe da realidade assim”.

Sobre bugs: sim, eles ainda existem, mas hoje em dia são bem tranquilos. Peguei alguns glitches bobos aqui e ali que não afetaram a gameplay nem a história. Tive apenas um crash durante toda a campanha, o que, considerando a fama inicial do jogo, já é praticamente um milagre tecnológico.

A otimização ainda é meio capenga. O jogo roda bem, mas parece depender bastante de gerador de quadros pra ficar realmente suave. Na DLC (que é excelente, inclusive) o FPS cai um pouco em algumas áreas. Sinceramente? Acho que isso já entrou no modo “assim mesmo”, porque dificilmente vão mexer mais nisso.

Na gameplay, tem aquele clássico problema de RPG misturado com FPS: alguns inimigos viram verdadeiras esponjas de bala. Não é algo que destrói o jogo (faz parte do sistema de progressão) mas confesso que nunca fui muito fã dessa mecânica.

No geral, Cyberpunk 2077 facilmente entrou no meu top 10 jogos favoritos. É um jogo grande, cheio de história e com um mundo que dá vontade de explorar por horas. Inclusive, recomendo jogar nas férias ou quando tiver bastante tempo livre, porque é muito fácil se perder em Night City.

E claro: vale muito a pena comprar em promoção.

Nota: 9/10 — um mundo cyberpunk incrível, críticas sociais afiadas e conteúdo suficiente pra te fazer esquecer que o sol existe lá fora. Só lembre de levar tempo livre… e talvez um purificador de ar (e uma boa placa de vídeo).

Comprei Cyberpunk 2077 no lançamento, em dezembro de 2020. Na época, o jogo estava longe do estado ideal: havia diversos bugs, glitches, problemas de desempenho e várias mecânicas que não funcionavam como o esperado. Mesmo assim, eu conseguia me divertir explorando Night City e acompanhando a história principal.

Decidi jogar novamente este ano e a diferença é impressionante. Após anos de atualizações, correções e melhorias feitas pela CD Projekt Red, o jogo se transformou completamente. Hoje, Cyberpunk 2077 é uma experiência muito mais polida, estável e imersiva do que era no lançamento.

O que mais me marcou foi a qualidade da narrativa. Os personagens são extremamente bem escritos, cada um com sua própria personalidade, motivações e conflitos. Ao longo da jornada, acabei me envolvendo emocionalmente com várias histórias secundárias, algo que poucos jogos conseguem fazer tão bem. Completei todos os finais disponíveis e cada um deles trouxe reflexões diferentes sobre os temas centrais do jogo, como identidade, humanidade, ambição e mortalidade.

Outro aspecto que gostei muito foi a evolução do personagem. O sistema de progressão oferece diversas formas de construir o seu V, seja focando em combate direto, furtividade, hackeamento ou uma mistura de estilos. Os implantes cibernéticos também são um dos pontos altos da experiência, permitindo modificar o corpo do personagem com novas habilidades e tecnologias que realmente impactam a jogabilidade.

Além disso, a ambientação futurista de Night City é simplesmente incrível. A cidade é vibrante, cheia de detalhes e transmite perfeitamente a sensação de viver em um mundo dominado pela tecnologia, pelas megacorporações e pelas desigualdades sociais. A direção de arte, a trilha sonora e a atmosfera contribuem para tornar o universo de Cyberpunk extremamente imersivo.

E o mais impressionante é que ainda nem joguei a expansão Phantom Liberty. Pelo que vi da comunidade e das análises, ela é considerada uma das melhores expansões já lançadas para um RPG moderno, trazendo uma nova região para explorar, personagens marcantes e uma história de altíssima qualidade. Se a campanha principal já me proporcionou uma experiência tão positiva, minhas expectativas para a expansão são ainda maiores.

Na minha opinião, Cyberpunk 2077 representa um dos maiores retornos da história dos videogames. A CD Projekt Red conseguiu recuperar a confiança de muitos jogadores após um lançamento extremamente conturbado e entregou um RPG memorável. Recomendo fortemente para qualquer pessoa que goste de jogos de RPG, progressão de personagem, liberdade de construção, ficção científica e histórias marcantes. Foi uma experiência que me surpreendeu positivamente e que certamente ficará entre os melhores jogos que já joguei. 🤠

[h2]【良いところ】[/h2]
■ 圧倒的な密度と退廃的な美しさを誇る近未来都市「ナイトシティ」の没入感：どこを切り取っても絵になる圧倒的なグラフィックと、幾重にも入り組んだ巨大なサイバーパンクの世界観の作り込みが凄まじい。ネオンが輝く夜の街を愛車で駆け抜けるだけで、まるで本当にその世界に生きているかのような唯一無二の圧倒的な没入感を味わえる。
 
■ ジョニー・シルヴァーハンドとの関係をはじめとする重厚でドラマチックな物語：主人公Vと伝説のロッカーボーイ（キアヌ・リーブス演じるジョニー）が脳内で織りなす奇妙なバディ関係や、死期が迫る中で自身のアイデンティティを問うシリアスかつエモーショナルなストーリーテリングが非常に引き込まれる。
 
■ 多彩なビルド構築と爽快感あふれるサイバーウェア・戦闘アクション：銃撃戦、刀やモノワイヤーによる近接戦闘、敵をハッキングして無力化するネットランナーなど、自分のプレイスタイルに合わせた自由度の高い育成とスタイリッシュな戦闘が最高に楽しい。

[h2]【悪いところ】[/h2]
■ 発売からの改善はあるものの時折顔を出す不具合や挙動の粗さ：大型アップデート（2.0や拡張パック）で劇的に生まれ変わったとはいえ、NPCの不自然な挙動や物理演算のバグ、進行不能系のエラーがゼロではなく、細かなところで興ざめさせられる瞬間がまだ残っている。
 
■ 没入感を損なう警察システムの不自然さや一部警察AIのチグハグさ：改善されたとはいえ、犯罪を起こした際の警察の湧き方や追跡AIの挙動にはまだ大味で不自然な部分が多く、オープンワールドの犯罪都市としてのリアリティに少し水を差す原因になっている。
 
■ メインの緊迫感に対して寄り道が多すぎる構造の中だるみ：脳内のタイムリミットが迫っているという緊迫したメインストーリーの設定がある一方で、マップ中に溢れる依頼やサイドジョブの数々が膨大すぎて、物語のテンポや没入感の維持がプレイヤーのプレイスタイル任せになりすぎてダレやすい。

This game is one of the most fun games I ever played. First person shooters can be pretty hit or miss for me, but this game starts off incredibly fun and it only gets better as you level up. There are a LOT of ways to customize your character, from weapons, to skills, to clothes, and to cyberware, and you can really create some interesting combinations. Plus, there is so much leveling! Normal leveling, plus skill progression, plus street cred! By the end of the game, I'm a powerhouse with armor, health, weapon damage, and resistances, mowing my way through whatever crosses my path.

The main issue is the story SUCKSSSSSSSS. There are fun and interesting parts of the story, but a lot of it is slow and unskippable. I've done the main story all the way through twice, and there are so many dead moments. There is also a lot of slow walking behind someone, sometimes while they explain something you can't skip. There are a lot of times where you have to [spoiler]fight as Johnny, removing any and all upgrades/cyberware/weapons you've gotten but keeping the level difficulty. You get thrown into a completely new playstyle at a high level with no way to manual save! It's the only part of the game I really die in.[/spoiler]

Plus, [spoiler]I love Keanu Reeves, but Johnny is ANNOYING. I liked him the first playthrough, but he actually lies to you/misleads you/misrepresents things a LOT and he shames you for things you have no control over. Plus he bothers you all the time. And your relationship is applied inconsistently. Why am I being forced to say I hate him when I spent the entire game building rapport? Why am I forced to say I like him around when we have no relationship to speak of? There are times where he tells you to do something, and if you don't do it, you're treated like an idiot by the game, and there are times where you are treated like an idiot if you DO listen to him. It's all very confusing and jarring. [/spoiler]

Speaking of characters, Judy and Panam are fine, but the male romance options are TERRIBLE. You have a [spoiler]corrupt cop who tries to play puppy after dragging you through corrupt cop shit[/spoiler] and then you have [spoiler]the 80 year old rockstar who is still in love with the man in your head who tries to destroy three girls careers because he's a bitter washed up asshole.[/spoiler] Plus, both male romance options are side quest locked, so completely missable, while Judy and Panam are met through the main plot.

Heck, even Judy has her problems. Judy [spoiler]is left sad in all endings except one that has nothing to do with her. Why am I becoming distant and shitty to her in the mansion ending? My V wouldn't do that?[/spoiler] I haven't finished the Panam romance yet, but it's... weird so far too.

Also, the gigs. There are so many gigs with secret requirements that aren't communicated in anyway. Sometimes it will say "Don't be seen (optional)" but a LOT of times, the game expects you to be stealthy or not kill people or whatever and you only find out at the end of the mission when the fixer is disappointed in you. It happened with EVERY fixer, to the point that I dropped a save before EVERY gig so I could go back and do it again in case of secret expectations.

The biggest sin of the story has got to be the extreme cynicism. By the time I was getting to the end of the game, I knew that if I was going out of my way to save someone, there was a pretty high chance they would [spoiler]kill themselves.[/spoiler] It literally just kept happening. There are so many times where you try so hard to do good things, and it almost feels like the game is laughing at you for trying. I actually really like grimdark, gritty, and cynical media, but this was almost unpalatable in some cases because instead of "everything is literally as bad as possible, but you can do something" it very much has the feeling of "everything is bad and you're stupid for thinking you could make ANYTHING better." There are a couple places where you can do something, but it's mostly punished in my experience.

All this to say, the story is frustrating and mean and painful. There isn't a single ending [spoiler]where you don't die,[/spoiler] which has some foreshadowing, but it really feels like the last f u to [spoiler]give you hope and then show you that it's hopeless.[/spoiler]

The reason I have 184 hours (and why I will almost certainly have more) is that the gameplay is genuinely so fun. I feel like I can recommend this game, despite all the huge issues, because you can literally just not play the story. I have a character right now that I started with phantom liberty, but instead of doing the DLC, I just ran around and did all the NCPD side quests and killed enemies wherever they showed up. That it the real fun of the game. Running around the map with your cool abilities and awesome guns and mindlessly killing stuff to level up. I could, and have, done it for hours, and it's something I've even used to relax.

I would say get this game on sale and be prepared for the slog to get to the good stuff, if you are willing. If you aren't willing to wade through everything above for a fun, brainless, in game murder spree, I don't recommend this game.

CD Projekt Red has obviously improved a lot by now, and I want to put the initial launch problems aside for this review.

I think that if you go into this game with the right expectations, Cyberpunk 2077 delivers everything you could ask for. A very well-written story that is presented beautifully, and a combat system that works well and offers different playstyles.

Anyone expecting the same kind of sandbox experience as GTA will be disappointed. You can explore the world, but you can’t really live in it. Minigames, activities outside of combat, and other simple things to do are only marginally represented here.

Nevertheless, Cyberpunk 2077 works well as a full-fledged RPG.

I don’t think I need to say much about the graphics. Depending on your budget and what kind of high-end PC you have at home, everything is possible, from a polygon paradise to razor-sharp photorealism.

The game looks beautiful. The city feels full and alive. I will say that the first-person...intimacies...are a bit awkward for me lol. I love all the little easter eggs and the extreme attention to detail. I am loving the story and have a real interest in where it is leading and what ending I am going to end up getting. 

I don't like driving the cars at all. They seem to float over the road. Any time I have the option I take the motorcycle as I found that much easier to handle.  There are some minor bugs - objects and people floating, the environment lighting getting orange washed, permanent blur- but a reload cleared up most of them and a restart took care of the rest. The thing that annoyed me the most as that it crashes like a release day Bethesda game - often and frequently at the worst times.

However, if you plan to play it on a laptop I would be very, very cautious, I got through around 20 hours of the game before it began to slow down even further than it already had and became pretty much unplayable, we're talking lowest possible graphics and a solid 5fps. I'm lucky enough to now play on a decent PC but I would make sure your device can handle the bulk of this game before getting too invested.

I have waited long enough to make this review, and I mean Holy **** what a comeback. We are talking about a rushed mess with a disaster of a launch by one of gamings top studios, to what I can after over 800hrs logged between all copies I own (240 on steam alone at time of making this review) confidentally now say is one of the best RPG's of this Generation...

So let's look back quickly, year is 2020, Cyberpunk releases and it's just a horrid buggy mess. I mean to the point that Playstation pulled it from the PS4 store and refunded people, which as any playstation user can tell you, refunds can be hard to get from PSN. But instead of calling it a wash and moving on, CD Projekt RED hunkers down, radio silence, and they start to work. I'm talking patch after patch, fixing their game, shaping it into what into what it was meant to be, until it happened. UPDATE 2.0/Phantom Liberty releases, not simply just adding more content storywise and otherwise, that was not good enough, no, CDPR releases an entire overhaul of the game that not only improves the game, it changes the very way it plays, FOR THE BETTER! They fix the skill system, balance out overpowered builds, but in a way that with thought and work you can still be powerful but with the feel that no one is a perfect god like person, well at least without a little work.

Visual: Depends on you, I mean that in the best way, Night City is beautiful, and with the right specs it only gets more beautiful. This game is truly next gen and if you are into modding, you can get it looking hyper realistic where you start blurring game to IRL, all you need to do is hit up youtube and you'll see everything from realistic concrete to pores in the skin textures.

Sound: The Sounds of Night City do not disappoint, walking around the city, you will hear the chatter of the masses, horns of cars, the ads from the billboards that tower the city, right down to distant gunfire, or the hum of the neon lights, and speaking of guns, they sound loud, dangerous and deadly.

Gameplay: Gameplay is nice......depending on where you play it and your preference. PC is of course the place to play, either it be mouse/keyboard, or like myself a Xbox Series X controller. There is tons of content between the main story, side gigs, cyberpsycho gigs, NCPD Scanner gigs, random encounters, easter eggs, etc. as of Update 2.3 we have more customization with vehicles and I won't even add in Phantom Liberty whic adds more story, more side gigs and way more customization with new clothing, and new relic perks.

Price: As of early 2026, Cyberpunk 2077 goes on sale often, but honestly I would say its worth it's normal full price, my opinion, although do yourself a favour and buy the ultimate edition that comes with Phantom Liberty. Look Phantom Liberty is a diamond, don't rob yourself of that beautiful experience.

Once again got it as a gift from a good friend, but it was a plan to get it either case as it is an amazing game.
The review will be for both the base game and the Phantom liberty DLC, based on multiple playthroughs and exploring.

First of all I will mention my setup as for this game that is really important and it gives more prospective, processor i7-12700K, 32GB DDR5 @6000 CL30, nvidia 5060 TI 16GB, installed on a nvme drive. The game was run on 1440p with DLSS 4.5 forced with path tracing enabled and frame generation x3 for most runs.

[h3]Positives:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Well we have to start with the visuals, this game is extremely stunning with the visuals, on the first playthrough you will spend more time looking around than actually playing the game, it really dominates visually, especially with path tracing.
    [*]Attention to detail, you are going to notice it all over the place, especially small details that you would not expect.
    [*]The audio is the next thing that is also up there, and here the top place is for the prime example on how great it comes out when you get great voice actors, not to mention that the ingame radio has awesome songs, and the battle music really fits the whole atmosphere.
    [*]RPG elements are well made and balanced, you do get a bit overpowered but it fits the game lore perfectly.
    [*]Variety of weapons to use and there is something we haven't seen in other games, netrunning abilities, it adds a unique way of playing.
    [*]Map is big, with tons of things to do and explore, with many distinguish spots that look apart from each so you can feel that now you are in the different place.
    [*]A lot of vehicles to traverse the vast map, even though you have fast travel, you can use the auto driver feature to enjoy the scenery.
    [*]Many factions that are different in their looks, talk and way they react to you, each fixed in their own block with some overlaps.
    [*]And do not let me started with how many different unique characters you are going to meet in game, many are complex characters with twists.
    [*]Keanu Reeves - do I need to say more?!
    [*]Idris Elba - not as much bonding on the screen as Johnny, but he filled the role pretty good.
    [*]Story is great, it has all you need, ups, downs, twists, comedy, annoyances, rage, culminations, etc... it is nice that some choices do matter on the story.
    [*]You want to play guns blazing?! No one is stopping you, oh you prefer stealth, go ahead it is optimized for it, netrunning it more your thing?! Well you will be able to make some superb combos. I want to say, you can play any way you like there is no limit and the game is not hindering you if you do not play a meta build.
    [*]The game is extremely well optimized for fast pace movement and slow motion.
    [*]Multiple endings, each one being different and unique in it's nature, and the main thing that was a surprise, as I cannot recall the last game that had this, once you get to the ending you get to play a bit more afterwards to have that proper feeling that you reached the end.
    [*]I feel like this needs to be mentioned, as they are one of the proper good ones, the developers are CD project RED.
    [*]Modding!!! This is done pretty good, with full support on how to get into modding, so if you want to tinker around and learn to code a bit, it can be done, but it is easier to go on Nexus mods, and just download the ones that you like the most, more than 10000 mods available. ps You do need a an account there but it is free and fast to create.
    [*]There is a character creation, it has fairly good options to create unique looks.
    [*]Great option from the developers, you can enable mature filter and it will hide certain scenes and characters will have at least underwear, this is really good as without this you would not be able to stream on youtube for example many parts of the story for example. There is also an option to remove songs from the radio that are copyrighted.
    [*]Optimized for DLSS, FSR, XeSS, choose whichever based on which video card you have, you lose a bit of quality that you will not notice unless you are looking for it hard and in return you will gain a nice boost in fps ( depends from system to system and the ingame settings you are using ).
[/list] 

[h3]Negatives:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]It still has issues, none of these are game breaking in a sense that you cannot fix all of them by either restarting the game or reloading a save game. I did get 2 game crashes as there is still a memory leak issue, happens mostly if you teleport many many times in quick successions and once when I overdid it with forcing the mod to spawn more police. Sometimes your dashing will put you through the floor, sometimes kerenzikov will not work.
    [*]Have to mention this, there is a one big inconsistency with the story that bothers me, without spoiling it, you will figure it out once you replay it.
    [*]Many choices are there as props and have no impact, which is a failure in my opinion, you force me to react but I get nothing no matter what I do.
    [*]As mentioned above, attention to detail is always a double edged sword, if you add some things and then fail to make others that are expected to be working, not work... is jus disappointing.
    [*]Even though there is plenty of weapons to play with, it felt poorly optimized for this masterpiece, simple example once you find the one iconic that fits your play style that is the only thing you will use for, in some cases, 90% of the game. Weapon modding is also simplified, compared to how cyberware was done, this felt like -lets just add this as an option. Prime example - why give me a silencer for an AR or SMG, if you cannot use it as a stealth weapon, to hear it a bit less? To have a cooler sound when you shoot?
    [*]Takedowns could have been done better to add more variety.
    [*]You do get to create your own character, visually I mean, but it felt more of just being there as an option that leads nowhere as you do not get to see yourself at all, except at the endings.
    [*]This is a personal opinion based on very hard difficulty, but it is a bit biased as the playthroughs were consecutive, the fighting becomes boring because you do become too overpowered soon, especially if you explore around, it does fit the lore. I had to give myself additional tasks to make it interesting.
    [*]Some of the mods would be better if they were part of the game to begin with, once you add some of them you do not want to play it without them anymore. This is not a negative per say but more of a notice.
[/list] 

[h1]VERDICT 9/10[/h1]

Definitely a big [b]YES[/b]on this one, and by this one I mean both the main game and the phantom liberty, the DLC is a must, it not only adds to the levels and skills, but enriches the story on it's own, you do get a great storyception there that fits perfectly with the main game.

[h1] Эпоха [/h1]Скорее всего, после этой игры не захочется играть в другие игры ещё долгое время... Проходил игру множество раз, сначала на PS 4, потом GOG-версию, после этого решил приобрести в Steam. С момента последнего прохождения игра сильно изменилась, переработали боевую систему, добавили новые ветки скиллов, новые квесты, локации и транспорт. Особенно нравятся бои с Макс-Так. Игра оставляет сильное впечатление, особенно сюжетом, интереснейшими глубокими персонажами, история которых запоминается надолго и общей атмосферой. Музыкальное сопровождение к игре стоит отдельных похвал - практически все треки, так или иначе, погружают в гущу событий, происходящих на данный момент в игре. Красивые локации и пейзажи города тоже заслуживают отдельного внимания (я давно не делал столько скринов, как в этой игре). Боёвка, не скажу что самая простая (на ультра харде), вышла очень динамичной и адреналиновой, но сбалансированной - ты убиваешь за пару ударов или выстрелов, и тебя точно так же могут убить, особенно если играть от дробовиков, пистолетов и клинков, приправляя всё это Сандевистаном. Физика езды на транспорте неплохая, просто неплохая. Но сами автомобили очень красивые и, по-своему, колоритные. Особенно заметно внимание к несущественным деталям, что, по-моему, свидетельствует о том, что игру делали с любовью. К сожалению, баги в этой игре тоже есть, но они незначительные и порой смешные, геймплею они никак не мешают.

Что могу сказать.
Думаю ни для кого не будет новостью что судьба у игра не легкая.
Я покупал игру на консоль в день релиза. И хоть я не встречал критических багов, но недоработки были видны невооруженным глазом.
Тогда я забросил ее и после выхода Песьего города дал ей еще один шанс уже на ПК.
И это было правильным решением!!

Оптимизацию подтянули, переработали кучу механик и добавили новые, исправили баги и ошибки.
Короче говоря сделали конфетку.
Я прошел на все концовки, выбил все достижения, облазил кучу скрытых мест - это был кайф!
В плане боёвки и стрельбы не могу сказать что меня что-то сильно впечатлило.
Ближний бой и холодное оружия 90% времени я игнорировал, огнестрел хороший но не ВАУ.
Сражения были просто частью сюжета или вынужденной мерой. Взлом и игра преимущественно по стелсу мне были интереснее.
Если бы была возможность со всеми как то договориться или задавить чисто "авторитетом" - было бы намного круче, но думаю реализовать это в подобном мире очень не просто.

Сюжет прекрасный, твои действия и ответы правда на что-то влияют. Потому что концовок ни 2, ни 3, и даже ни 5, их 10!!!!!
Могу сказать что пройти точно стоит все. Мне больше всего зашли с автобусом и казино.
Можно прорываться сквозь толпы врагом с катаной/имплантами, можно устроить жесткую перестрелку, можно взламывать и скрываться от вражеских взглядов - и выбор тактики сильно меняет ощущение от прохождения. Больший кайф получат те, кто любит отыгрывать какой-то класс перса и придерживается своей тактики в любой ситуации.

Итог такой - если вы не боитесь долгих игр и готовы погружаться в мир, 100% надо брать и окунаться в этот мир.
И совет - поставьте мод на несколько имплантов, чтоб совмещать хакерскую деку вместе с сенди или чем то еще (но это немного нарушает баланс как мне кажется, хотя ГГ бегущего по краю был именно так напичкан). А про машины, оружие и графические моды смотрите уже по желанию и по возможностям вашего ПК. Я играл на 11400 и 3060ти с ФСР на ультра с лучами(без овердрайва), все было супер и по графике и по производительности.

Но этот мир...это что то невероятное. Исследовать его - сплошное удовольствие!
Ты просто залезаешь туда куда, как ты думаешь, никто и не предполагал что ты залезешь, а там сундук/посхалка/или еще что-то. 
Едешь по пустыне и видишь матрас, лег поспать, просыпаешь и видишь рядом записку что появившийся перед тобой биг-фут теперь твой. Топчешься по свалке, находишь сканером странный холодильник, а там тело нетраннера с историей как он умер и декой ведущей к небольшому квесту.  Катаешься по заброшенной промзоне, видишь крутую тачку в стиле Хуникорна в ангаре, рядом шкафчик с запиской и ключами.
Мир просто напичкан интересными вещами, это цепляет и разжигает желание проверить каждый уголок мира не в поисках лута, а ради историй и событий.

P.S. Дэвид Мартинез R.I.P. <\3

[h1][b]Мрачное будущее[/b][/h1]

Что ж, пришло время для моего обзора. Не знал как сформулировать мысль, ведь хочется рассказать про все сразу, но вот как это связать, тут пришлось подумать. 
Небольшое предисловие: обзор больше субъективный. По сути застал весь жизненный цикл киберпанка от релиза до актуальной версии. 

Игра происходит в альтернативном развитии нашей истории, а именно в 2077 году, в вымышленном городе Найт-Сити. Ведь какой еще город может подойти, как не город возможностей? Сам город отлично показывает саму суть жанра киберпанк, даже просто перемещаясь по городу. Этот контраст очень бросается в глаза. Нарратив, что корпораты является элитой понимаешь без слов. И этим игра погружает в себя очень сильно. Безнадега, отчаяние пронизывает улицы. Каждый выживает как может, ведь иначе город поглотит. На улицах также образовываются банды, регулирующие определенные территории, и имеющие терки между собой. Ну и технологический скачок в виде имплантов, которые уже стали обыденностью.

Я люблю иногда в играх просто ездить по городу или ходить осматривая локации, проникаясь атмосферой. И тут меня встретила неожиданность. А именно повтор нпс. И если вы задаетесь вопросом, а что не так? Ну подумаешь, иногда повторяются, игра все же. НО! Мне хватило меньше 30 секунд, чтобы увидеть 4 одинаковых персонажей в одном кадре. Это при максимальной плотности толпы. Насколько это бьет по атмосфере, ну, думаю, очевидно. И это не единичный случай. 
Сленг также отлично дополняет этот мир. Многие выражения выглядят инородно для нас, но для них - обыкновенная реальность. И это просто отлично работает на атмосферу. 
Также жители не совсем простые болванчики, они реагируют на действие игрока, хоть иногда странно. 

[b]Персонажи[/b]

Ви - наш главный герой, наемник, мечтающий стать легендой. Но что такое быть легендой и как ей стать? Вот это и предстоит узнать. А также и узнать цену, которою необходимо заплатить, чтобы осуществить задуманное. На пути мы повстречаем много персонажей. Каждый из них запоминается, они хорошо прописаны, у них есть характер. И правда, переживаешь за них, хочешь помочь или наоборот расстраиваешься из-за различных ситуаций. Даже мимолетные персонажи, настолько завораживают своей харизмой, что остаются в памяти до самого финала. Действительно верится, что такой город живой, что так персонажи могли бы реагировать и выглядит это очень органично. Что только стоит один Джонни Сильверхенд. Как происходит взаимодействие с ним, то, как именно мы узнаем его ближе, и, даже, становимся друзьями просто великолепно. Он не упустит возможности прокомментировать тот или иной сюжетный поворот или сделает колкий комментарий. Его взаимодействие с Ви одно из лучших, что есть в игре. А Вик, Мисти, Джуди, Эвелин, Панам, Керри и другие? Все они, опять же, ведут себя как живые люди, у которых полно своих проблем и переживаний. А внимание к деталям тут проявляется еще благодаря разным телефонным звонкам, сообщениям. Очень неожиданно и приятно было, когда персонажи звонят и проявляют обеспокоенность, хотят обсудить ситуацию, приободрить и так далее. Это действительно заставляет верить в то, что мир живой.		

[b]Сюжет[/b]

Сюжет в игре глубокий, довольно трагичный, не боящийся задавать вопросы, нам, игроку. Разработчикам удалось написать историю так, чтобы я искренне радовался или грустил. А концовки... да... Оставляют послевкусие. И у меня часто возникали противоречия, бывало задумывался о событиях. Весь пройденный путь падает тебе на плечи, тот груз, те решения, что ты пронес через всю игру действительно влияют на тебя. Многие сайдквесты не хуже основных, и как же они дополняют историю. Ну вот не хочется покидать этот город, этих персонажей. Хочется остаться тут подольше. Очень затягивает!

[b]Боевая система[/b] 

Под стать городу, твой стиль игры зависит от тебя. Не хочешь пачкать руки, а быть невероятным хакером? Прокачивай нетранерство. Хочешь быть неубиваемой машиной для убийств? Пожалуйста, различных оружий тут предостаточно, каждый найдет для себя что-то свое. Многие локации можно пройти различным способом. Иногда определенный стиль очень сильно упрощает выполнение того или иного квеста. Прокачка навыков выглядит в виде древа. Мне не понравилось в нем то, что даже после эндгейма нельзя полностью прокачаться. Хотя, возможно, это сделано чтобы у игроков была возможность создавать различные билды и не становится имбой. 
Импланты, мне кажется, нужно впихнуть сюда. Довольно большой простор для экспериментов. Они, все же, более вспомогательный характер имеют, но не стоит их недооценивать. Каждый из имплантов упрощает сражения, исследование и это позволяет еще детальнее строить свой билд. Тем не менее, в своих прохождениях я слишком быстро стал имбой. Мне кажется, так не должно быть.

[b]Транспорт[/b]

В игре довольно много машин, так что каждый найдет для себя свою "ласточку". Машины тут отличаются разной управляемостью и скоростью, что очевидно. Хотя некоторые экземпляры слишком странно поворачивают. Также дизайн некоторых довольно специфичный, но не выделяющийся из общей стилистики. Вот что точно хотел бы указать, так это неудобное расположение камеры во время езды от первого лица. Вот тут не знаю, чем разработчики смотрели, но ездить так мне очень неприятно. Тут пришлось ставить мод. 
Еще есть рабочая система метро. Реализовано все хорошо, хотя мне не хватило тут иммерсивности. Я имею в виду, тут сделано как-то чуть "по-игровому". Просто выбор станции, условно черный экран и ты в вагоне. Нет вот этого перемещения от станции в вагон. Хотя, возможно, я слишком многого хочу. 

[b]Техническая часть игры[/b]

Ну с релиза много воды уже много утекло, уже давно игра хорошо оптимизирована. Также добавлен режим трассировки пути. И это просто вау. Игра выглядит просто фантастически. Настолько невероятной графики, игрой света, реалистичных теней я не видел. Если вы играли без трассировки пути, обязательно попробуйте! Это того стоит, хоть и достаточно ресурсозатрнатная технология.
Баги в игре еще остались, но практически все незначительные. Правда один раз выпал за карту, но некритично т.к. практически сразу вылез. Повторно попасть под карту не удалось хех. А чуть не забыл, насчет миникарты. При выборе квеста, соответственно прокладывается путь, и он отображен на ней. НО ОН КРИВОЙ. Это правда может показаться смешным, но когда вы будете ехать на высокой скорости и будет развилка с двумя похожими поворотами, то есть вероятность, что пропустите нужный. И тут появляется другая проблема. Маршрут не всегда (вообще довольно часто у меня было) быстро перестраивается. Он упорно показывает, что мне нужно развернуться. Ну это выглядит странно.

[b]Итог[/b]

Для меня киберпанк одна из лучших игр, в которую я играл. Сюжет, атмосфера, графика, геймплей на высшем уровне. В каждой детали видно, что разработчики вложили душу в этот проект, они горели этим и хотели рассказать нам, игрокам, незабываемую историю. И, на мой взгляд, они справились с отличием. Даже после конца игры, остаются вопросы, тоска, чувство пустоты. И это действительно показатель качества. Вероятно, когда будет анонс второй части я предзакажу эту игру, хоть практически никогда такого не делаю. 
  
Но главный вопрос так и остается без ответа:

[i]"Что же ты выберешь: тихую жизнь или смерть в лучах славы?"[/i]

Достойная игра: рубить бошки, смотреть на красивые локации в которые ты никогда не попадешь, потому что родился в обычной смертной семье, создать неформального персонажа и выбрать мощную грудь, давать деру на мопеде. Сюжет тоже так то прикольный, но когда я пошла выполнять дополнительное задание и мне не хватило денег на бой, произошел некий флешбек, который на секунду вернул меня в реальность и дал понять что я грязь из под ногтя. А так игра супер, класс, sex.

От Киберпанка реально двоякие впечатления. С одной стороны, Найт-Сити — это просто отвал башки. Первые часов десять ты тупо ездишь под крутую музыку, пялишься на неоновые вывески и веришь в этот мир. А потом магия ломается. Ты вдруг понимаешь, что город — это просто красивая картонка. Зайди за угол от сюжетного квеста — и всё, пустота, мертвые болванчики ходят туда-сюда чисто для массовки.

Сюжет и Джонни Сильверхенд тащат на себе вообще всё, тут без вопросов. Диалоги крутые, личные квесты персов сделаны с душой. Но основная ветка... почему она такая короткая и рваная? Тебе всю дорогу орут "Ви, ты умираешь, счет на дни!", а игра тут же вываливает тонну заказов в духе "съезди убей бандитов". Темп истории ломается напрочь.

Геймплей — ну, обычный шутер. РПГ-элементы прикрутили чисто чтоб было. Половина перков дает какие-то унылые +5% к урону, прокачка вообще не ощущается, что на старте, что в финале стреляешь примерно одинаково. ИИ врагов тупой как пробка, стелс работает через раз. Про физику машин даже говорить не хочется — на байках еще куда ни шло, но авто ездят как утюги на льду.

В общем, сейчас игра работает нормально, багов стало меньше, но осадочек никуда не делся. Это хорошая история с крутыми персонажами в потрясающих декорациях. Но как полноценная RPG в живом мегаполисе — увы, недотянули

[h1]Графика и техническое состояние[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Плоский день и пластик:[/b] даже если включить максимальные настройки с лучами, в полдень игра выглядит откровенно плоско, блекло и серо - как средние игры прошлого десятилетия. Ночью ситуация заметно лучше, но все равно не покидает ощущение, что это старый добрый польский шутер, на который навалили кучу современных модов в стиле киберпанк. В динамике все эти швы лезут наружу
[*] [b]Пластиковые манекены:[/b] модели второстепенных персонажей и случайных прохожих выглядят откровенно дешево, вблизи они больше напоминают кукол. На фоне детально прорисованных ключевых героев и неоновых лучей под максимальными настройками эта безликая пластиковая толпа сильно бьет по погружению
[*] [b]Оптимизация и костыли:[/b] нативного фпс на моем не самом слабом железе игра выдает всего в районе 40 кадров. Без костылей в виде генерации кадров, неизбежно ведущей к визуальным артефактам, играть на ультрах с трассировкой путей невозможно - проект полностью полагается на технологии апскейлинга. Качество картинки далеко не всегда соответствует прожорливости игры
[/list]

[h1]Физика и картонный открытый мир[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Транспорт:[/b] физика автомобилей и мотоциклов при вождении от 1-го лица очень порадовала. Судя по всему, патч 2.0 действительно дал о себе знать, полностью переработав поведение машин. Контроль очень приятный
[*] [b]Железобетонный мусор:[/b] при этом интерактивность окружения часто отсутствует. На полной скорости влетаешь на мотоцикле в обычный пластиковый пакет с мусором на свалке - байк встает намертво, как об бетонный дот, а пакет даже не шевелится. Из-за таких мелочей мир иногда кажется картонной декорацией
[*] [b]4д-аттракционы на пассажирском сиденье:[/b] сцены, где тебя везет нпс - это просто позор уровня заставок старой колды. Физическая модель машины в этот момент полностью отключается, транспорт просто летит по рельсам, как на воздушной подушке. А иллюзию движения разработчики пытаются создать за счет топорного покачивания камеры, как в дешевом игровом автомате. Это очень бросается в глаза
[/list]

[h1]Лоботомированный ИИ и мертвые скрипты[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Тупость нпс:[/b] искусственный интеллект здесь просто отсутствует. Устраиваешь аварию на дороге - окружающие водители вместо того, чтобы в ужасе выбегать и разбегаться, просто сидят на месте и орут, глядя в лобовое стекло. В пустошах поймал карикатурный баг: нпс просто зашел в костер, простоял там минуту, сгорел и умер. При этом чел рядом с ним максимально спокойно сидел и продолжал играть на гитаре. Системы мира вообще не общаются друг с другом
[*] [b]Паузы в диалогах и пиксель-хантинг:[/b] все сшито белыми нитками и постоянно спотыкается. В скриптовых сценах между репликами персонажей периодически возникают странные нелепые паузы по 5-10 секунд. Собеседник просто исступленно смотрит на тебя в тишине, как будто игра залагала, пока движок разродится выдать следующий кусок кода
[*] [b]Квестовые триггеры:[/b] это отдельный сюр. [spoiler]Например, в задании с Панам после спасения Соула она предложила мне свою снайперскую винтовку. Я ее забрал, и Панам просто безмолвно уставилась на меня, пока я стоял в полуметре от нее.[/spoiler] Скрипт не завершался, пока я интуитивно не догадался обойти ее мотоцикл с другой стороны и не встал на конкретный невидимый пиксель, который задумал польский программист
[/list]

[h1]Корявый геймплей[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Стелс:[/b] максимально неуклюжий по причине не лучшего ИИ противников
[*] [b]Режиссура миссий:[/b] иногда скатывается в архаичный калечный тир. Во время очередной миссии тебе дают пистолетик для отстрела погони с пассажирского места. В итоге преследующие машины вообще не пробиваются и едут со скриптовым бессмертием, а в самом конце сцены внезапно взрываются с двух тычек просто потому, что шоу закончилось. И это не единственный пример. Выглядит нелепо
[/list]

[h1]РПГ-элементы, которых нет[/h1]
[list]

Yet another mixed bag, but an interesting experience nonetheless. Some disclaimers first: I do not own the Phantom Liberty DLC, so keep in mind that my review will not touch on any of it. And I am aware that this game has been discussed to death already, so I'll make this as subjective as possible, and focus on my personal experience.

This game is the first to give me the Deus Ex feel since the original Deus Ex was released 26 years ago. Some people will eviscerate me for uttering this but Dishonored sure tried, and failed, being mostly carried by Viktor Antonov's brilliant art and design, may he rest in peace. But Cyberpunk 2077 really gave me that "you can tackle a task any way you see fit" that I relish so much (the closest being Dark Souls because building around STR, DEX, FTH and INT all feel really different from each other).
I LOVED the hacking, whether it was computers, machines, or people's brain implants. I loved that the stealth was almost always optional, only bringing you more money or a better reputation in some cases. I loved that you could disobey your missions, for example convincing someone to leave town instead of killing them, and it still counts as a win. I felt more freedom than in GTA even.
I even tried to Mirror's Edge it from roof to roof as often as I could just to see if it was viable... and it was very doable at least half of the time, it even helped in certain missions. That was great. 

This game follows a pattern that I've seen in so many open world games especially since 2017: the main quest is dogwater, sidequests are where all the fun's at. Interestingly, Cyberpunk 2077's three best quests had the exact same plot: some AI is starting to sound too human, and people do not like that (Delamain, Skippy, Brendan). Here's one piece of advice: do NOT give the talking gun to Reggie. Worst mistake of my life.

The music was great, but could it have been any different with Marcin Przybyłowicz at the helm of the audio department?

The graphics... OK, this is where things get complicated. They are all over the place.
On one hand you've got stylish art direction, and fantastic attention to detail (I remember zooming in on characters in Photo Mode and admiring how unique their belt buckles looked)... on the other hand, this game has the worst vLOD issues I've seen since Dark Souls 3 and you can constantly see models gaining and losing polygons right under your nose, which is very distracting and immersion-breaking; and on top of that the clipping is so bad that it sometimes made me feel I was playing a Nintendo 64 bargain bin game. Annoying. I guess that's a very aggressive way to optimise? I was getting around 90 FPS in 4k high settings with no DLSS and RTX off (and honestly this game has the best looking RT I have ever seen but it did tank the framerate to a cinematic mid-twenties, no thanks). There were also some weird cut corners, like all children looking like adult heads on shrunk bodies for example, or a flashback sequence taking place more than 50 years in the past where the city looks exactly the same and people dress the same as in 2077 (and use the same slang too). What the fuck?  

The game, as you know, has a Bethesdaesque amount of bugs. I saw almost constantly cars randomly falling from the sky, people half buried into the pavement, or enemy blood unexpectedly changing colour... many such cases. I've seen games with more bugs obviously... but not with a budget like that one.
The writing was also all over the place but I think that was by design. Nice characters suddenly acting like assholes and vice-versa solidifies the feeling of a morally gray society where you can't trust appearances and nothing is reliable. Although I felt like some aspects were oversimplified. Helping cops does not make your street cred go down? Come the fuck on! 

All over the place is what I'd call most of this game. The writing was globally good but there were strange incoherencies and inconsistencies, as if the writers didn't agree on a lot of things. Sometimes it felt like they were trying to make the characters appear more complex... sometimes it seemed very random and nonsensical.

There's a million errands to run so obviously they become repetitive, but also if you simply walk around and explore you'll never run out of XP, money and loot. This plethora is probably punishing for people who want to 100% the game and get all achievements, as always I'm glad I'm not one of them anymore. Also if you decide to help the cops here and there, half of the time they thank you and the other half they start shooting you and call reinforcements despite the fact you just did their job for them. That could be intentional though.

But in all honesty, what I liked the most about this game is the fashion. I spent a lot of time admiring people's style, and much more time even going to absolutely every clothing outlet, trying to curate the biggest and coolest possible wardrobe. I really locked in when it was time to create new outfits. It's what kept me excited about the game half of the time.

Oh and the combat? It's okay. The majority of weapons felt useless to me, 99% of the time I used shotguns, grenades and offensive hacking, sometimes revolvers. It was a bit chaotic, but it was fine. Using people's implants against them was definitely the best part.

I don't know if I should recommend this game or not because it's definitely an acquired taste. It's one of those games that have a lot of everything, and your brain needs to be wired for that. I personally love that but I can totally see how it can be a turn-off. There's lots of dialogue and lots of reading to do. There's also lots of gunfights, and it's during the same missions. Lots of shit to learn if you wanna really appreciate the game, but also lots of action. The pace constantly goes from slow to fast to slow to fast... it never stops being a rollercoaster. Think you can handle it? Then absolutely go for it, this game is not mind-blowing but still a pretty good time.

De um lançamento desastroso a um dos melhores jogos que já joguei, enfim, Cyberpunk 2077.
Já adianto que não sou muito fã de primeira pessoa, porém, a imersão com a temática, atmosfera e mecânicas casam muito bem.

Estava procurando um jogo diferente, com uma proposta fora da mesmice e com uma pegada de ação, encontrei ele na promoção e resolvi dar uma chance pra esse jogão.

A história cheia de detalhes e caminhos, personagens cheios de carisma e únicos, carros maneiros e diferentes entre si, armas complexas e simples, combate personalizável ao gosto, ambientação da cidade que, diga-se de passagem, é ÚNICA em todos os jogos atualmente, dando uma imersão absurda ainda mais em primeira pessoa tornando Night City muito viva e diversificada, tornam o jogo uma obra prima simples de entender, gostosa de se jogar e sem ficar maçante mesmo após fazer todo o disponível.

A trilha sonora da rádio é boa e tem uma ligação legal com a história, fora a narração que é impecável ainda mais no PT-BR.

Pra não falar que é mil maravilhas, ainda existem alguns bugs simples como por exemplo um corpo impossível de lootear, iluminação variando, entre outros, porém, em 125 horas de gameplay não fiquei preso em nenhum que tenha bugado a ponto de recomeçar uma missão, precisar morrer para recomeçar ou ficar emperrado em algum canto aleatório.
このゲームに関してはストアページやどこかしらで動画とか見て、この世界感たまんねーなーやってみたいなぁって思ったら買えばいい。それ以外にあれこれ言う必要もないくらい最高。ストーリー進める前に意味もなく自販機で飯買って食ってるだけでこのゲームを買ってよかったって俺は思った。

When I first heard about this game, it didn’t have the best reputation, to be honest… and I’m sure most people reading this know exactly why. But as someone who gave it a chance despite the bugs and its bad reputation, I’m really happy to see how it has turned into such a solid, almost legendary game over the years!

If you’re wondering whether it’s still as buggy as it was when it first came out, I can happily confirm that the devs did an awesome job cleaning up the mess from launch. Now you can play without wanting to do your enemies a favor and shoot yourself in the face! Jokes aside, this game is a solid 9–9.5/10 for me.
The story is fantastic and keeps you on the edge of your seat, wanting to learn more about the characters and the world the game builds. Night City feels alive at every hour and everywhere you go. There are tons of missions and side quests to keep you busy for a long, long time. The customization is also huuuuuge so you won’t feel like NPC #7847, you can create a unique and cool character with the cyberpunk aesthetic we all love.

The gameplay is also fantastic and fast-paced. Almost every mission has multiple ways to complete it, so you can have fun finding the most efficient, funniest, or most chaotic way to get the job done ;)
There are also tons of builds and abilities to fit your favorite playstyle. Want to be a hacker who lurks in the shadows? Go for it. Want to be a berserk brawler who fights on the front lines? You can do that too. The possibilities are almost endless!

Unfortunately, even though it’s a great game, it has a few flaws. Some missions can feel repetitive the more you play, since many follow similar patterns. If you don’t enjoy this kind of game or really dislike repetitive missions in open-world games, it might not be for you. Also, even though the devs have fixed most of the problems, there are still a few minor bugs that can be annoying, but they’re much rarer now.
With all that said, Cyberpunk 2077 is an excellent game that has redeemed itself in a way few games can claim. If you decide to give it a try, you might discover one of the coolest and most interesting worlds and stories in gaming. The DLC is awesome too, so if you get the chance to pick up both, do it without hesitation!

cyberpunk is honestly one of those games that just pulls you in and keeps you there. the world is insanely in depth and night city feels alive in a way very few games manage to achieve. everywhere you go there is detail, environmental storytelling, conversations happening around you, and little moments that make the city feel like it exists beyond the player.

the attention to detail is one of its biggest strengths. from ads playing on buildings to unique interiors, npc routines, and the sheer verticality of the city, it creates this immersive feeling that you are part of a real place. the lively spirit of the world mixed with the darker undertones of corporate control and personal struggle makes the setting hit even harder.

interactions and missions are another standout. side quests rarely feel like filler and many of them have strong narratives, memorable characters, and meaningful choices. the writing carries a lot of emotional weight and helps build connections to characters that stick with you long after the mission ends. main story moments especially land well and feel cinematic without losing player agency.

gameplay wise the build variety, cyberware system, and combat approaches give you freedom to play how you want. stealth, hacking, gunplay, melee, or hybrid setups all feel viable which adds to replay value and experimentation.

as for flaws, the biggest one is performance demand. running the game at full graphical quality can be extremely taxing and requires strong hardware to truly experience everything the visuals offer. ray tracing, crowd density, and lighting all look incredible but come at a heavy cost performance wise. outside of that though the game stands incredibly strong.

overall cyberpunk is a 10/10 type experience and easily sits in a top 10 games list. the immersive world, detailed design, strong storytelling, and memorable missions make it something special and despite hardware demands it remains one of the most impressive modern rpg experiences.

Cyberpunk 2077 — A Love Letter to Night City

This is my first Steam review, and honestly, it'll probably be my last. But if there's one game that deserves me taking the time to write something, it's this one.

I bought Cyberpunk 2077 at launch. Since then, I've owned four copies of this game: two on Xbox, one on PlayStation, and now one on PC. I just got this PC, and choom, you better believe this game was one of the first must-haves on my library list. Some games you play, finish, and move on from. Others leave a mark on you. This is one of those games.

After all these years, I still want to come back to Night City. Let's get one thing straight: Cyberpunk 2077 had a rough launch. Nobody needs to pretend otherwise. But what matters to me is what happened afterward. CD PROJEKT RED could have taken the money, cut their losses, and moved on to the next big project. Instead, they kept working. They listened, rebuilt systems, fixed problems, expanded the experience, and continued pouring time and effort into a world they clearly weren't ready to abandon.

From the massive gameplay overhaul in Update 2.0, to the quality-of-life additions in 2.1, the customization and Photo Mode improvements in 2.2, and the incredible Phantom Liberty expansion, this game has continued to evolve. Each major update brought meaningful improvements, new ways to experience Night City, or more reasons to lose yourself in it. The developers didn't just patch up a busted BD and call it a day. They kept pushing to make the experience better and that deserves credit.

In an industry where some companies seem content to release a half-baked product, cash in, and delta to the next project, supporting a game like this feels like making a statement. It tells the industry that putting genuine love into your product can still earn you eddies. That players notice when developers care. That a studio willing to stand behind its work, learn from its mistakes, and keep improving deserves recognition and support.

I'm not saying every game needs years of post-launch work to become what it should have been at release. I'm saying that when a studio genuinely puts in the effort to improve its game, that effort shouldn't go unnoticed. CDPR deserves credit for the work they've put into bringing this experience to where it is today.

But here's the thing that really makes Cyberpunk 2077 special to me: it's not just the gameplay, the combat, the chrome, or the sheer amount of things to do. It's the world itself. Between the game, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, and the wider lore of this universe, you start to realize something. V might be the protagonist, Johnny might be the legend, but Night City is the real main character.

Night City is a place that chews people up and spits them out. It's corrupt, cruel, violent, and hopeless in ways that feel uncomfortably believable. Corporations own lives. People sell pieces of themselves for a chance to survive. Everyone is chasing something, whether it's fame, freedom, power, love, or just one more day breathing. Most people won't become legends. Most people won't even get a happy ending and somehow, CDPR made this place absolutely gorgeous.

The neon bleeding through the rain. The crowded streets. The towering megabuildings. The advertisements screaming at you from every corner. The quiet moments in an apartment, the music playing while you cruise through the city at night, and the little details you only notice when you stop rushing from one gig to the next.

It's a city I can hate for everything it represents and still find myself wanting to return to. A city that feels alive even when nothing is happening around me. A city where the stories aren't just in the main quests, but in the people, the streets, the shards, the conversations, and the countless little details scattered throughout the world.
That's worldbuilding. That's atmosphere. That's a setting becoming something more than a backdrop for a video game.

And the lore makes it even better. The game and the shows don't just exist alongside each other; they make the world feel bigger. They show different sides of the same nightmare, different people trying to survive the same machine. You begin to understand that Night City doesn't care who you are. It doesn't care if you're a nobody, a merc, a corpo, or someone dreaming of becoming a legend. It'll keep turning long after you're gone and somehow, that's what makes it beautiful.

I've bought this game four times, across three platforms, and I don't regret a single copy. That's how much this world means to me. And now that I'm on PC, I'm ready to jack in all over again.

So, to anyone still on the fence: if you've been waiting for the right time to experience Cyberpunk 2077, this is it. And if you're already a Night City veteran, you know exactly why some of us keep coming back.

To CD PROJEKT RED: thank you for giving us a world worth getting lost in, characters worth caring about, and a game worth coming back to. Thank you for continuing to work on something that could have been left behind. The road here wasn't perfect, but the result is something special.

In Night City, you either become a legend or you become another forgotten name. But every once in a while, you find a story that stays with you long after the credits roll.
This is one of those stories.

Cyberpunk’s generational comeback needs to be studied. From a horrible launch to a game whose polish allows you to see it for the absolute gem of an experience that it is. Night City is an absolutely gorgeous city. When first beginning my playthrough, I would just get lost in the city. I’d drive, travel by NCART (Night City’s public metro system), or even walk through the streets. There is also a desert area outside Night City called the Badlands that breathes even more life into the game, reminding you that it isn’t just a city you’re exploring, but an entirely different world lush with its own lore and backstory. The only flaw of the open-world setup is that there isn’t much to do in the world (outside of missions) compared to games like GTA. But Cyberpunk has a large number of story-heavy interactive missions that will have you doing a variety of things, and the game gives you the freedom to accomplish many missions in whatever way you like (stealth or guns blazing). The dialogue you pick on these missions can also dictate how the mission ends. I personally found myself repeating the missions over and over because I hated one outcome and wanted to get another one. However, you’ll learn quickly that many missions don’t have a “perfect” outcome, and the outcome YOU like will depend largely on YOUR morals and personal values. The main plot of the base game is pretty good, but if you pick up the DLC, you’ll realize Phantom Liberty’s story is S-tier. The characters themselves are also pretty good (and the PL characters are especially good). The combat of the game is also a big selling point. You can customize your character in a variety of different ways. You can play like a “samurai” with a katana, a regular merc with a gun, etc. You can choose many different abilities according to the cyberware you equip. Equip a sandy? Now you’re moving like the Flash and murdering enemies before they even see you coming. Equip a cyberdeck? You are effectively the closest thing Night City has to a god because you can hack other people’s cyberware and it can go from basic stuff like overheating their cyberware to forcing people to kill each other. If you play Phantom Liberty, you can gain access to a netrunning ability that is so powerful, it's unspeakable in this review. There are many other cool abilities in this game as well, and I’d heavily encourage experimenting. As for the soundtrack, A-tier. The game has many awesome radio songs and battle themes, including one song that you may recognize if you watch the Cyberpunk anime. Overall, this game is absolutely worth checking out as it has so many amazing things going for it - setting, soundtrack, gameplay, characters, and plot. You will find yourself sucked into this huge city of hopes and dreams, and carving your name in history as a legend.

Cyberpunk 2077 is a comeback story. I went in expecting chaos. I stayed for the city, the story, and the vibes. Night City feels alive. Neon, grime, noise, attitude. It pulls you in fast. The writing hits harder than I expected. Characters feel real. Side quests actually matter. Combat feels good now. Builds are fun to mess with. Stealth, hacking, guns blazing. Your call. It finally plays the way it should have from day one.

What worked for me.
• Night City is insanely immersive.
• Story and characters stick with you.
• Side quests are legit, not filler.
• Combat and builds feel flexible and rewarding.
• The game feels stable and polished now.

What still bugs me. I just wish I could change views, not stuck on first person view. I want to see my character move through the city. I want to see my drip during fights. Second or third person view would make exploration smoother, combat more cinematic, and cruising Night City way cooler. If I spent hours building my character, let me actually see them exist in the world.
