Three years ago, this game was a disaster, but today, after the 2.0 update and the Phantom Liberty expansion, it is a completely different product with great mechanics and a GOAT atmosphere. If you quit because of bugs back in 2020, now is the perfect time to come back. The new skill trees finally allow for real specialization because every point you spend actually changes how you move or fight, rather than just adding a tiny damage bonus. This makes every battle satisfying, whether you use a katana or hacking. The new cyberware system also limits how much gear you can install, which forces you to plan carefully since every choice has real consequences for your stats.
Night City is immersive with its neon lights, and the new Dogtown area is even better than the original districts because it is more detailed and packed with content, so it no longer feels empty. The story in Phantom Liberty feels like a political thriller with complex characters like Solomon Reed and Songbird, making every moral choice difficult and heavy. The improved AI and new police system make the city feel alive, as it now reacts to your actions in a logical and challenging way. On the other hand, driving is still not great because cars slide too much, which is frustrating during fast chases. Also, some side activities can feel repetitive after many hours. Despite these small flaws, the graphics look amazing with path tracing, and the deep story makes this one of the best action RPGs on the market, so it is definitely worth buying the full bundle.

A ambientação também é sem igual, Night City é uma das melhores cidades que eu já experienciei em um jogo, ela é parte da história do jogo, e personagem tão importante quanto qualquer outro. Porém, achei a história (apesar de muito boa) não tão incrível quanto de the witcher. A dinâmica entre V e Johnny é muito boa, mas eu sinto que quase todos os personagens coadjuvantes são ou esquecíveis ou não combinam com o jogo. Por exemplo, acho que a Panam é um péssimo romance pro V, na minha cabeça os dois não tem nada a ver, Takemura também é um coadjuvante que tem seu charme por conta da fantástica dublagem, mas é um cara que você não consegue se importar muito. Viktor e Misty (principalmente Viktor) já são personagens que eu me importei. Os coadjuvantes que mais me importaram foram o Jackie e a Evelyn, e ambos morrem com pouquíssimas horas de jogo, sendo extremamente mal aproveitados. Enfim, é um jogo excelente, principalmente em questão de gameplay, mas gostaria de ter visto personagens melhores, vindo de uma empresa tão competente em contar histórias.

It's very difficult to pin down my feelings about this game. The promise of its potential is more satisfying than sitting down and playing it. Years and years of patches, and it still feels like it might break at any moment, (and in fact is broken most of the days of the year). The immediate thought I have whenever I reinstall 2077 to give it another shot is, "man, this game feels like shit."

The gameplay teeters between mediocre jank and downright bad, but the thought of its potential pushes it forward. The promise of good writing propels me through middling side activities and decent story missions, but never quite meets expectations. Characters are believably real, but never so interesting that they cross my mind when not on screen. For every good moment there is a swamp of bad, or even just ok moments. 

The ultimate failure of 2077 is that its just kind of... ok. If you have any interest in the setting at all, you will probably enjoy the game. Rest assured, the next game Projekt Red releases will also be broken forever, and kind of good.

My thoughts on this aren't fresh, but in short this game will probably go down as one of my favorite RPGs of all time, and certainly my favorite for first-person RPGs. High praise for sure, but the presentation and immersion of this world alone has such draw factor for me that I felt as if I was there in Night City. My experience with this game got me to go watch the anime, check out the (included) TTRPG CP2.0.2.0. and buy and play CP:Red, and some of the music gets a listen from me outside of the game.

I am typically one to enjoy games for mechanics and developing skill at playing the game, so DOOM: Eternal, Dark Souls/Bloodborne/Elden Ring and games like it tend to be what I invest time into. But this game pulled me in from its story and characters, and was able to make me genuinely care about them more than any other game in my memory has.

At its core it is a FPS with RPG mechanics, so if you can handle yourself in an FPS you'll have no issues there. What far and above makes the game special is how it represents the world of Cyberpunk and allows you to (albeit mostly through combat) immerse yourself in it and, well, roleplay. I do wish there was more depth and options in 'social' interactions, like if you had to interact with the corps that own the chrome you buy or spend more time in areas that the unnamed NPCs travel in and out of constantly. More of the slice of life events and interactions are needed for the sequel, and on that note as someone that doesn't really engage in romance in games we desperately need things to do with our chosen partner. Just showing them around the apartment and having them stay the night is nice and all, but I was hoping we could have them drive around with us or do some kind of GTA IV date minigame to keep that immersion of living in Night City.

I also think having some semblance of a morality or infamy system would further aid in that immersion; are you a solo that specializes in key targets and you're known for clean assassinations, or are you that solo that's on the verge of cyberpsychosis that just slaughters every banger in the area when you go hunting? Are you such a feared 'runner that corps buff their security or send Netrunners after you to eliminate you? Sure, making a name for yourself is a plot point and one of the drives of V in the beginning stages of the game, but we don't really feel the effects of being one of the most capable and involved characters in the city in 2077. We don't get recognized or interacted with outside of major characters, and while those are great and well written the verisimilitude can fall apart at the edges if you stop to look outside the plot and instead at the immersive sim aspect of the game. The presentation, while in my opinion some of the best we've seen in gaming, cannot make up for the lack of world interactions.

These are things that I hope CDPR is working to include in the sequel, but what we have here is still a truly special FPS RPG experience that I wish I had experienced sooner. I think I'm due for a revisit to Night City...

+ 优化差、bug多、性能堪忧，好在N网的MOD能解决一部分问题，能想象吗，平均每半个小时就能碰到一个新bug，模型消失，人物漂移，卡在车上下不来，车辆鸣笛停不下来，家里的收音机奇吵无比却无法关闭，性能测试有严重问题……数不完，不数了
+ 完美继承了《巫师3》PC版的光照问题（我在GOG上玩了巫师3超过250个小时），室内环境死黑
+ 社区里反映了很久的bug坚决不修复
+ 一言难尽的简体中文本地化，举个最简单地例子，我用的是英文配音，听到街上一个小孩骂我，头顶上的翻译是“我饿了”
+ 人物是穿模的，世界中大量模型和贴图错误（有MOD可修复，MOD制作者免费帮开发人员上班）
+ CDPR启动器更是bug得一塌糊涂，每次打开，50%的bug卡死几率，最终靠跳过启动器直接启动游戏解决的

游戏是拿出来卖的产品、商品，发布多年了，连最基本的质量保证都做不到，玩家反映很久的恶性bug没人管，甚至室内光照问题都完全继承自上代游戏作品。虽然游戏肯定免不了有bug有各种各样的问题，但2077太过了，这些问题在游玩的时候时不时地提醒你，这款游戏/产品质量很不好


[b] 游戏体验部分 [/b]

+ 空洞的开放世界。必须承认，2077整个世界的设计、建模，还是非常有潜力，相当不错的，但倒反天罡地讲一句，这款游戏，浪费了这个城市的设计和建模。整座城市不过是个方便剧情上演搭建起的戏台，出了故事主线，世界便与你毫无关联，顶多摆放了好些据点供你游玩。CDPR还记得最早火线夜之城你们是怎么宣传你们的世界的吗？
+ 夜之城的开放世界游戏体验，甚至远比不上育碧的罐头开放世界，更别说育碧的开放世界罐头优化好、质量高。以早两年、2018年的刺客信条奥德赛为例，NPC会对主角的行为做出各种反应，偷鸡摸狗甚至会被居民抄起扫帚追着打，整个世界NPC的一举一动，休闲游戏、聊天对话、唱歌跳舞、市民活动，全在告诉玩家，这里是古希腊。反观夜之城，这座漂亮庞大的城市无时不刻不在提醒我，这是个死气沉沉的游戏世界，我只是在里面游玩，整个世界与我无关。超级糟糕的驾驶手感和城市加载与掉帧问题，令城市风光旅游都变得非常难受
+ 总有一些不舒服。在巫师3里（不知道后面更新的次世代版还会不会这样），商店不会刷新，虽然我不知道基于什么原因，一款现代游戏的商店会设计出不刷新这种机制，但它就这样，受着吧。2077同样继承了这一点，比如，未装备的物品没有物品分类；武器上的配件和芯片前者能拆卸后者不能，一不小心点到就得读档；再比如，你的第一套房子非常方便，出门就是传送点和售货机，但武器房的房门不是自动门，对准开关点一下才能开，买的其他房子门是自动的了，可传送和售货机又离得很远，最起码得点一下实实在在的上下个电梯；车载广播不能从设置上彻底关闭，有几首歌特别洗脑刮躁的歌经常突然蹦出来令人暴躁

设定是未来的赛博朋克世界，却没有任何设定之外的“未来”“赛博朋克”体验，一切干瘪、空洞、毫无代入感，充满了糟心的体验，某一次退出之后，虽然也会偶尔想起剧情，想起手头上的任务，游戏依旧呆在硬盘上，却再没有任何动力进去了。
发售五年再玩依然经常闪退，我玩过的闪退最严重的游戏，不敢想刚发售时是何等盛况；锁第一视角对晕3D的很不友好，英配经常跟中文字幕对不上，估计翻译有点问题；但确实很好玩，DLC演出尤其精彩，音乐很棒，剧情还行吧，大世界探索很有趣，喜欢捡垃圾的有福了

This game is amazing. I purchase it 6 years ago on release and never played it because of the horror stories about performance and bug issues. 

After 75hrs into my playthrough (Meet Hananko at Embers is burning into my monitor) I can confidently say this game is a masterpiece and I'm glad I waited for CDPR to iron out the issues before I put time into it. The Netflix show that resulted from this game's creation was also excellent.

I highly recommend trying this game. You can literally do combat however you want. Want to beat people to death with your bare hands? Slice them to pieces with swords? Melt their brains with quickhacks? Stealth around killing everyone silently? Bust down the door guns blazing? Imagine however you want to play, you can do it.

Playing on 2.31-- There are quite a lot of bugs, some of which are very inconvenient-- I had to download a mod to be able to rebind all the keys for example. Performance is reasonable however. There's also some poor design choices once in a while; the bosses are lackluster. The story and writing is decent, but not astounding. Similarly the sci-fi elements and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners connection weren't as compelling as I expected. If you can get past the vice and the garbage "aesthetic" coating every square foot, there is prodigious content. The city feels huge, and there's plenty of guns, cars, clothes, and cyberware to try. The perk system makes it easy to try out different builds. The gunplay(weaponplay really) and build variety are highlights and there's enough missions to support these long beyond the main story. The stealth is decent  too but definitely usually more fun to ignore. Don't forget to peruse some mods! (I recommend "baby driver"  to make driving manageable and "equipment-EX" for unlimited wardrobe.)

关于赛博朋克2077的游玩体验及感受
 
      当问起出圈的3A游戏，毋庸置疑，必定是这部正宗的美式RPG作品，《赛博朋克2077》。它的爆火，一部分因为其打出的宣传：开放世界，赛博朋友，未来科技，这些标签无论出现在何时何款游戏上都是十分吸睛的存在，另一部分则是系列衍生番《赛博朋友边缘行者》的播出（现在来看，可能更多的应为后者）本人也是在25年暑假看完番后抱着对大卫故事的遗憾与对夜之城的憧憬，在steam秋促买下了它，但那时刚玩完艾尔登法环的几十h主线，并未对所谓的3A祛魅，想着3A的游戏时，流程一定很长，再者临近开学，于是便只好暂时放下对夜之城的向往，游戏也在库中吃灰。
      中途虽曾几次拾起，却望着周末那挤不到一天的时间，却又好望而却步。今年暑假末，当我抱着闲着也是闲着的心态，打开这款游戏，我便有了新的感受。流程并不长，若只推主线的一个结局大致20h便能落户（但我是一个喜欢打开一款游戏，便想解锁全结局、全成就的收集控，所以花了大概60h左右，我观看了全部结局。）
       接下来便是对这次体验的一点总结，希望对各位盒友有帮助。
关于剧情，我认为主线做的过于潦草，回顾整个主线就像是在喂你吃一份预制菜，即通过强尼的往事与杰克的死来让你强行流泪，在强尼刚出场后，我原本预想的是后续主线会以V的故事与强尼的回忆两条线并行，在V的故事中穿插补完强尼的背景故事，但直到结局，关于强尼的剧情也仅存在于主线部分与克里支线的一部分，这也直接导致了人物塑造的扁平化。我对强尼角色的印象正如剧情中所言“满嘴脏话鼓吹反抗的愤青”（虽然我懂制作组肯定想法并非这样）。但有一点值得肯定的是，核心剧情紧紧围绕着“无名小卒还是扬名天下‘’，而各个结局也确实能使人深刻意识到“夜之城没有活着的传奇”的主旨，而支线任务也并没有给人很深的印象，且不说帮居民找东西，解决赛博精神病这种千篇一律的重复性任务，连解锁结局的重要支线中，我能有兴趣玩下去的也只有赛车任务与帕南支线（别的不说，家族人真义气，有事是真上啊）以及罪与罚能排的上号了。
      关于游戏性设计：有些网上有部分玩家所称道的路人的台词设计使人很有沉浸感，让人感觉他们似真的置身于街头，但我个人认为，这种说法是根本站不住脚的，首先，台词的设计有两个目的，一是增加沉浸感，营造为剧情服务的环境，二是增加了游戏交互性，使故事更加有趣。但其实2077中的台词设计，只能算是平平无奇。初入游戏时，听一听路人的对话觉得饶有趣味，但随着游玩时间被拉长，重复的模式磨平了新鲜感。行走于大街上，你所能体会到的只有那充满屏幕的聒噪，或是抱怨，或是脏话，可能制作组的本意是想体现在夜之城这种资本主义高度发展的社会背景下底层人民饱受剥削的压迫，但此种设计似乎并没有达到这种效果，也并没有增强其给玩家带来的沉浸感。
       关于玩法：在搜攻略时，便见有人这么评价：这款游戏更类似于一个半成品。游玩下来后，也确实有点这样的感觉，但我觉得更贴切的来说，它并没有找到一个核心的玩法，虽然玩法众多，但总能找到一款平替。如驾驶系统，毫无疑问，在夜之城这款赛博朋克风未来都市，你马路上风起，车不真实令人心神惆怅，我在清支线时，甚至更喜欢不用快速移动，而是开车前往，然后也是我最想吐槽的便是这个游戏的车底盘和抹了肥皂一样难控制。拐弯开到人行道后撞到行人会被NCPD通缉，这时候要么进入任务对话要么开往其它区域甩开NCPD，不然只能重新回到上个存档点，（或者直接找出武士刀大杀四方直到引来警察暴力部队将你打死（GTA乱入）再因为其他大大小小的问题，这部作品中驾驶的体验是远不如地平线这种竞速大作的。又如游戏中获得物品的方式是满屋子找亮光拾取，玩久真的会让我感到在玩辐射，（而且第一人称视角转动不灵活，玩到后面有点头晕）。就再说地图设计方面，宣传时的开放交互令人惊喜而实际上手发现有的方面的确有些敷衍，如大部分门无法打开，等电梯时间过长，以及商店的重复性（666演都不演了，同种类型的商店卖的东西都大差不差）。
      最后要提到的便是审美设计角度，地图中每个区域似乎并没有各自的鲜明的特点（至少并没有让几十小时游玩下来的我有很深的印象）并且大街上随处可见的性偶店及情色产业广告与脏话，真的有些令人感到低俗，厌恶。其次就是人物的建模，不多说了，LGBT懂的都懂。
      从结果上说，有《边缘行者》的加持，这部作品在知名度上称得上成功，但就其作品本身与其游玩体验来说，并不让人满意，或者说与它的荣誉相比，差之甚多了。
My Game‑play Experience and Reflections on Cyberpunk 2077
 
When it comes to well‑known AAA games, Cyberpunk 2077, a genuine American‑style RPG, undoubtedly springs to mind. Part of its massive popularity stems from its promotional selling points: an open world, cyber‑punk aesthetics and futuristic technology — labels that draw huge attention in any video game. Another major factor, arguably the more important one, is the release of its spin‑off anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
 
I bought the game on Steam’s Autumn Sale after watching the anime in the summer of 2025. Deeply moved by David’s story and fascinated by Night City, I was eager to step into this world. At that time, I had just finished dozens of hours of main‑story gameplay in Elden Ring, and I was still excited about AAA‑title experiences. Assuming the campaign would be extremely long and facing the approaching new semester, I set the game aside, and it sat untouched in my game library.
 
I tried to get into it several times later, yet I hesitated, since I barely had a full free day on weekends. Toward the end of this summer vacation, I decided to play it just to kill time, and it gave me brand‑new impressions.
The main story itself is fairly short. You can finish one single ending in roughly 20 hours. As a completionist who loves unlocking every ending and achievement whenever I start a new game, I spent around 60 hours to see all of its endings.
 
Below are my thoughts on this playthrough, hoping they will be helpful to other players.
 
In terms of storytelling, the main campaign feels rather underdeveloped. The whole narrative is like serving players pre‑cooked food: it tries to force emotional reactions through Johnny Silverhand’s past and Jackie’s death. Right after Johnny first appears, I expected the main plot to alternate between V’s personal journey and Johnny’s memories, with Johnny’s backstory gradually revealed in V’s timeline. Instead, Johnny’s character development is confined mostly to the main questline and a small portion of Kerry’s side missions, which results in a flat characterization. To me, Johnny comes across exactly as described in‑game: “a foul‑mouthed rebel ranting about resistance”, though I understand this was hardly the developers’ full intention.
 
To its credit, the core theme revolves around the dilemma: to remain a nobody or chase fame and glory. Every ending powerfully drives home the central message that “In Night City, no legend lives.”
 
Still, most side missions fail to leave a lasting impression. Putting aside repetitive filler tasks such as fetching items for civilians or hunting down cyberpsychos, even major side content tied to unlockable endings offers limited appeal. Only the racing missions, Panam’s questline (her clan is genuinely loyal and reliable when trouble strikes), and Crimes and Punishments stand out as memorable.
 
Moving on to game mechanics. Some players praise NPC dialogue for building immersion, making you feel as if real people fill city streets. Personally, I find this argument unconvincing. NPC dialogue serves two purposes: to build atmospheric immersion for the setting, and to boost interactivity to enrich storytelling. Dialogue design in Cyberpunk 2077 is merely mediocre. Early‑game NPC conversations feel interesting, yet repetition quickly wears away that novelty. Roaming city streets, players are constantly flooded with noisy complaints and vulgar lines. The writers presumably intended to depict the oppression of the underclass under highly‑developed capitalism in Night City, yet this design choice rarely achieves that goal and does little to strengthen immersion.
 
Regarding gameplay itself, some reviewers comment that the game feels like an unfinished product. Having played through it, I can see where this opinion comes from. More accurately, the game lacks a solid core gameplay loop despite its wide variety of mechanics, nearly all of which have better alternatives in other titles.
 
Take the driving system. Night City is built as a futuristic cyber‑punk metropolis, yet vehicle handling feels unnatural and awkward. I often skipped fast‑travel and drove across the city for side quests, but vehicle controls are slippery and frustrating. Hitting pedestrians on sidewalks triggers NCPD police pursuit. You must either enter a mission cutscene or drive far enough to shake off cops; otherwise you have to reload an earlier save. (Or you can grab a katana and fight until heavily‑armed police units gun you down — a very GTA‑style scenario.) Overall, driving mechanics cannot compare with dedicated racing franchises such as Forza Horizon.
 
Looting is another point of criticism: you hunt for glowing highlights scattered all over rooms to collect items, which quickly gives off Fallout‑vibes. Furthermore, the first‑person camera handles poorly and can cause motion‑sickness after extended play.
 
As for map design, the promised interactive open world falls short in multiple practical aspects. Many doors cannot be opened, elevator waiting times are unreasonably long, and shops suffer from obvious repetition: stores of the same type sell nearly identical merchandise.
 
From an aesthetic perspective, few city districts have truly distinct identities, at least not for someone who has poured dozens of hours into the game. The streets are saturated with advertisements for sex‑work establishments and non‑stop profanity, which often comes across as vulgar and distasteful. Character model design also leaves much to be desired, and the handling of LGBTQ‑related content speaks for itself.
 
Thanks to Edgerunners, Cyberpunk 2077 has achieved great fame and public recognition. Nevertheless, judged by its own gameplay experience, the game is far from satisfying, and it fails to live up to its widespread reputation.

It's also crazy that there are just so many low quality/missing features. GTA Online had callable cars that actually drove to you on release, whereas even after however many years, Cyberpunk's best effort is "spawn it instantly behind you and sometimes it won't glitch out".

An example of the poor story writing is Jackie: gets introduced, doesn't mind that you "ruined" a massive heist, suddenly best friends, "fast forward 4 months" trope, do one job, anti climactic death. Builds literally zero attachment to the character that's supposed to be your best friend, and kills him off immediately.

And the AI car guy: why tf would an AI car be doing you favours? The whole point of an AI is that it's supposed to be cold and efficient, which is what they paint it out to be when it's introduced. "No I can't deviate from the route, blah blah blah", 2 minutes later, "yes, I can go out of my way to come out of the city where I explicitly don't operate without guarantee of payment, that makes sense for a sophisticated AI with no connection to your character".

There is no sense of scale in the game, because the area design is so bad. The main city itself is pretty tiny for a AAA game, especially when so much of it is just empty filler. I was expecting to be wowed with a massive futuristic city that felt alive, but it's the complete opposite. You can really tell it's very much a patch job from the botched release, as still nothing that they promised before release is actually possible with exploration.

The game is still so average all this time later.

Even with heavy modding, the game just feels so dead. Story is pretty average, and there's still so many bugs after all this time. It's also crazy that there are just so many low quality/missing features. GTA Online had callable cars that actually drove to you on release, whereas even after however many years, Cyberpunk's best effort is "spawn it instantly behind you and sometimes it won't glitch out".

An example of the poor story writing is Jackie: gets introduced, doesn't mind that you "ruined" a massive heist, suddenly best friends, "fast forward 4 months" trope, do one job, anti climactic death. Builds literally zero attachment to the character that's supposed to be your best friend, and kills him off immediately.

And the AI car guy: why tf would an AI car be doing you favours? The whole point of an AI is that it's supposed to be cold and efficient, which is what they paint it out to be when it's introduced. "No I can't deviate from the route, blah blah blah", 2 minutes later, "yes, I can go out of my way to come out of the city where I explicitly don't operate without guarantee of payment, that makes sense for a sophisticated AI with no connection to your character".

There is no sense of scale in the game, because the area design is so bad. The main city itself is pretty tiny for a AAA game, especially when so much of it is just empty filler. I was expecting to be wowed with a massive futuristic city that felt alive, but it's the complete opposite. You can really tell it's very much a patch job from the botched release, as still nothing that they promised before release is actually possible with exploration.

I still remember the E3 trailers, and it looked completely different to what they eventually slopped out.

The only really good feature I like is the ability to fast forward through the endless dialogue; no, I do not want to stand in a hallway for 30 seconds listening to small talk whilst in the middle of a mission that completely breaks the immersion of a high-stakes stealth mission ffs. Oh, and on the topic of stealth missions, I love how your companions will just run through enemies and their line of sights because their pathing is so bad.

Cyberpunk 2077 es la impresionante construcción de Night City, una ciudad futurista vibrante y llena de vida que se siente auténtica en cada uno de sus rincones. Sus calles iluminadas por neones, los contrastes entre riqueza y pobreza, y la constante presencia de tecnología crean una atmósfera inmersiva que transporta al jugador a un futuro tan fascinante como peligroso.

Otro de sus puntos fuertes es la libertad de juego. El jugador puede desarrollar a V de múltiples maneras, especializándose en combate, sigilo, hackeo o una combinación de estilos, lo que permite afrontar las misiones de formas muy diferentes.

La narrativa también sobresale por abordar temas profundos como la identidad, la inmortalidad, la ambición y el impacto de la tecnología en la vida humana.
El juego destaca por su extraordinario apartado visual, la calidad de sus misiones secundarias y una ambientación cyberpunk cuidadosamente diseñada, convirtiéndolo en una de las experiencias más inmersivas y ambiciosas del género de ciencia ficción.

Cyberpunk 2077 brilla por su mundo abierto detallado, su libertad de personalización, su narrativa madura y una atmósfera futurista que logra sumergir al jugador en una ciudad donde cada decisión puede cambiar su destino.

This game is... pretty good! Its biggest strength is its setting. It's a joy to pop on the in-game radio and travel around Night City via a car or motorbike. 
Its second biggest strength is its premise. The idea of having the personality of a sh*thead has-been rockerboy stuck in your head after a merc mission goes awry is brilliant. 
This game had a pretty rough launch, but it seems like things have since been ironed out quite nicely, and in my experience the game was rather polished, with only a few janky moments here and there.
The main story was engaging, albeit a bit confusing. I rarely understood what was going on since the dialogue was full of techno-babble and references to various factions and individuals, but I enjoyed it anyway thanks to the vibes.
The core missions were fun. It felt satisfying to blast up enemies with a shotgun, pick them off with a sniper rifle, or slash them to bits with a katana. Sometimes, stealth was necessary as well - and this I found enjoyable too. The gameplay is fairly simple, but the moving story kept things feeling interesting, and the final act was fantastic. The boss fights, though few and far between, were exciting.
Some of the side missions are worthwhile characters-centric detours. Panam, River, Claire, Judy, Brendan and the Peralezes are some of the welcome personalities that populate the world, in addition to main-quest characters like Takemura and Jackie. But, the 'gigs' do expose the core gameplay as quite shallow when it comes down to it, and can be missed without losing much in my opinion. Options such as  quick-hacking and using smart weapons existed, but since the game never posed much of a challenge, these strategies did not ever feel necessary or worth exploring. The skill trees and cyber-ware provided a decent sense of progression, but mostly consisted of simple stat increases rather than providing interesting new abilities that affected gameplay.

What a ride. Didn't expect to be left questioning loyalty, survival, and how often “I’m trying to help you” means someones about to ruin your life.

After playing every ending, including Phantom Liberty, I changed my mind about some characters quite a few times. It went from understanding someone, to hating it, back to sympathize with them. The world and story excells in showing raw actions and consequences, while not judging directly anyone.

Major spoilers below. Seriously, play the game.

[spoiler]I won't go into the base game, as it allready aged and all loved and hated Johny, but he remained authentic.

Songbird was a tough one. I followed her path first, betrayed Reed, then spent half the journey wondering whether I backed the wrong person. She lied to everyone, to V, used his desperation to save herself. Meanwhile, Reed increasingly seemed like a man who genuinely wanted to get everyone out alive.

Fuck Myers btw. All that talk about duty and saving lives, while people become disposable the second they threaten her political interests. I wished I could have shot her the moment I met her.

I sent So Mi to the Moon first. Killing Reed didnt feel good. He believed in what he was doing, and I really hoped it would work out somehow. So I went back and handed her over. Reed alive, Alex alive, Songbird alive, yet back in FIA hands, but maybe Reed would help her. Seemed like a decent compromise.

Then I took the cure...
After spending the entire game looking for a way for V to survive, I finally got one. Two years in a coma, Johnny gone, Panam gone, almost nobody left. The life V fought so hard to keep had moved on without him. That fucking hurt and all of sudden those 6 uncertain months with people I cared about looked a lot more valuable than they had before.

The Arasaka ending had already left a rotten taste. I felt sorry for Goro, much like Reed: capable, loyal men who believe they’re doing the right thing, serving institutions that are perfectly happy to use them up. Even the rooftop suicide felt like it might spare everyone else until those calls showed what V would leave behind.

So I went back again. Betrayed Songbird in Firestarter. Watched everything fall apart. Alex died, So Mi lost control, and I started thinking she really was the root of the whole disaster.

Cynosure: that Cerberus sequence was fun and scary and I loved it. First time in a while that my V didnt feel like the overpowered killing machine.
Songbirds memories hit: before all this, she was basically a kid who wanted to become a great netrunner. Took a dangerous shot at a bigger life. Sound familiar?
But she didn't have V's luck to remain free for much longer, netwatch would have gotten her soon enough, so Reed thought recruiting her would save her.
Myers turned her into a weapon and kept pushing her into the Blackwall until she was losing herself. By the time she reaches V, Songbird doesn't trusted anyone, and tries anything for survival.
I know it doesn’t erase what she did, but I finally could see her perspective.

I played both outcomes in that bunker. After seeing everything, I came back to the Moon.

Save So Mi. Shoot Reed. Walk away from the FIA cure.

I still feel bad for Reed. Especially after seeing that he could begin questioning his loyalty for the F*ingIA in the other ending. I wished he could have reached that point before.
Also gave that medal to a begger, just like Songbird did.[/spoiler]

All in all it was a emotional roller coaster, absolutely fucking worth it.

So I will end with a quote from Johny:
"Swap meat for chrome, live a BD fantasy, whatever, but at the end of it all, it's the code you live by that defines who you are."

《赛博朋克2077》是一场用八年宣发泡沫和玩家信任堆砌起来的、至今仍未真正兑现承诺的世纪骗局。它在上世代主机上的表现堪称电子垃圾，PS4和Xbox One版帧数个位数、频繁崩溃、贴图加载失败，以至于索尼被迫将其从商店紧急下架。这不是什么“优化不佳”，这是根本不能正常游玩。PC版同样好不到哪里去，内存泄漏导致打开菜单越玩越卡，玩家被迫每十五分钟重启一次游戏才能继续。即便到了2.0版本之后，恶性Bug依然阴魂不散——黑客RAM倒转、叫车功能失效、潜行击杀莫名其妙强制进入战斗，这些都不是偶发故障，而是长期存在的系统性溃烂。CDPR用一次次补丁表演“救赎”，但救赎的前提是承认罪过，而他们至今仍在用“我们一直在改进”的话术逃避对首发灾难的实质性问责。

它的开放世界是一个精心粉刷的摄影棚，夜之城的美术设计越惊艳，越反衬出互动层面的贫瘠与虚假。批评者早已指出，它的开放世界“空洞得不行”，垂直探索等于零，可进入的建筑屈指可数，大部分大楼只是电梯固定通往某几层的摆设。公寓、饮食、超梦这些系统全部可有可无，和开放世界完全不搭边，本质上只是菜单里多按几下按钮的装饰品。支线任务“不是跑腿就是到一个地方打怪”，满地图的弱智委托占据了一半以上的游戏时间。所谓“夜之城”，不过是一张巨大的、好看的、不能真正与之互动的壁纸。

它的叙事结构存在根本性的自相矛盾，主线短到令人发指，不到二十小时就能通关，玩家刚打算在夜之城大展拳脚，游戏就告诉你可以去打结局了。杰克与V的“过命交情”全靠几段播片和几句台词硬凑，玩家还没和这个角色建立起任何真实的情感连接，他就死了，然后游戏指望你为此悲伤。与此同时，V被明确告知生命进入倒计时、意识正在被强尼·银手侵蚀，但玩家转头就可以去帮路人找丢失的猫、参加街头赛车、给艺人当保镖，这种叙事上的精神分裂让“亡命徒”的角色设定彻底沦为笑话。主线被压缩到极限的根本原因，是CDPR为了赶发售砍掉了大量本应构筑羁绊的剧情，把这些内容塞进了可捡拾的芯片文本里，然后用一个明星脸角色的出场挤占了主角成长的空间。

它的战斗手感是灾难级的，枪械射速失控、子弹瞬间打空，枪声软绵绵像在打气枪，敌人中弹的反馈几乎不存在，后坐力设计更是毫无逻辑可言。警察系统在首发时蠢到令人发笑——杀路人后警察直接在你身边刷新，开车跑了他们也不追，AI根本不会自主驾驶警车。2.0更新后警察变“聪明”了，结果是从一个极端滑向另一个极端：他们无处不在、什么事都要插一脚，玩家做任务时频繁被警察打断，社区怨声载道。2.0版本还以“平衡”为名粗暴削弱了黑客流等成熟玩法，武器词条系统被大改得面目全非，大量玩家发现曾经喜欢的战斗风格被强行阉割。这不是更新，这是对既有玩家群体的背叛。

《往日之影》被粉丝吹捧为“救赎之作”，但它本身就是一部自我矛盾的产品。DLC把本体中那个快意恩仇、可以单刷荒坂塔的V，塞进了一个精心设计的道德困境里，却不给玩家任何真正改变结局的手段，连破坏性的发泄都被剥夺了。叙事格调从本体的反叛狂欢变成了彻底的憋屈与无力，与本体建立的世界观和角色逻辑产生了严重冲突。新增的Relic技能树形同虚设，毫无可玩性，偷车任务环节重复、载具战斗折磨，DLC的画面风格甚至丧失了本体那种华丽的赛博朋克质感，退化成了一部普通的现实风格谍战剧。

这款游戏口碑回暖的背后，是一套高度成熟的粉丝自我催眠机制。说它Bug多就是“你配置不行”，说它开放世界空洞就是“你不懂赛博朋克氛围”，说它主线短就是“支线才是本体”，说它战斗手感差就是“你不会玩枪械流”。CDPR用一部高质量动画《边缘行者》转移了玩家的注意力，用2.0更新重新包装了同一个内核空虚的产品，然后粉丝们感恩戴德地宣布“它终于兑现了承诺”。不，它没有兑现承诺，它只是把承诺的底线从“不可能”降到了“勉强能玩”。一个花了八年时间和数亿美元宣发的游戏，最终的标准竟然变成了“Bug没多到玩不下去就算成功”，这本身就是对整个游戏行业质量标准的一次公开羞辱。赛博朋克2077的遗产不是它最终变成了什么，而是它证明了在足够大的宣发预算和足够宽容的粉丝群体面前，一款半成品可以走多远。

Game is definitely not bug free. In fact they are pretty frequent even after many updates. Despite this, on my PS5 and computer I have over 400hrs played. I really enjoy this game. The characters are fun if lacking after a while but for the time frame of the game (specifically about the time line in relation to the story) it a makes sense. It feels like there was thought and feeling with the game and if you can look over barriers of glitches and people flying away randomly, you can see the picturesque landscape and great voice work, attention to details and pop culture references littered throughout the world.

🎮 GAMEPLAY

Muy divertido y adictivo. Tiene una gran variedad de misiones, encargos y eventos. Además, hay muchas formas de resolver las misiones, junto con montones de builds y armas para que elijas tu estilo de juego.

El mapa es de buen tamaño, muy vertical y con muchas zonas para explorar. Hay bastantes lugares a los que puedes entrar y las localizaciones de las misiones están muy bien diseñadas.

👥 PERSONAJES

Cada personaje en Cyberpunk 2077 tiene su propia vida y pasado. Tienen historias que contar y misiones relacionadas con ellos, por lo que no se sienten forzados dentro del mundo del juego.
Sin embargo, me hubiera gustado ver más desarrollo en ciertos personajes.

🎙️ DOBLAJE

El doblaje es uno de los mejores que he visto. V habla en español de España, pero está muy bien logrado y no llega a cansar.
Me gustó que muchos personajes estén doblados respetando su nacionalidad y acento, lo que le da un gran punto extra a la inmersión.

🎵 BANDA SONORA

Gran variedad de canciones en la radio para todos los gustos. Además, el soundtrack de las misiones es una mezcla excelente de techno, rock, metal y hardcore que encaja perfectamente con la ambientación del juego.

🎨 GRÁFICOS

Buenos gráficos y muchos detalles en el mapa, personajes y objetos. Los reflejos con Ray Tracing son impresionantes y los efectos están muy bien trabajados.
Sin embargo, me encontré con un par de texturas algo raras, aunque nada que afecte realmente la experiencia.

🕵️ DLC: PHANTOM LIBERTY

Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty es, para mí, el señor de todos los DLC.
La historia es incluso mejor que la del juego base y las misiones están muy bien diseñadas. Incluso los encargos secundarios están extremadamente trabajados.

Me parece que dura lo justo y añade cosas muy interesantes al mundo del juego.

Hace años este juego salió muy roto y sin la mitad de las cosas que prometieron, pero actualmente vale totalmente la pena.
Ahora mismo es una gran experiencia.

I was late to the Cyberpunk 2077 bandwagon due to work, kids, and, you know, life. Anyway, I missed the horror show of the launch and came in when the universally beloved Phantom Liberty DLC dropped. If you came in early, YMMV, but my experience was universally good. The art direction, graphics, music and voice acting are all superb. 

The story was interesting, with plenty of fun side quests to get lost in. The combat felt chunky, and by the end I felt superbly powerful (a few boss encounters aside). Everything felt like it was in here for a reason. No open-world busywork climbing towers, collecting feathers, or hunting for hidden treasure. Just things that are, you know, fun. Other developers could learn a lot from this game.

Anyway, probably in my top ten games of all time. A must-play game 10/10.

[h1]Un avis plus structuré et plus pertinent 10/10[/h1]

[i]Cyberpunk 2077 est un chef-d'œuvre marquant, une expérience intense et inoubliable. Avoir exploré la ville dès sa sortie le 10 décembre 2020, traversé son lancement difficile, pour finalement y passer plus de 1350 heures sur GOG et le finir deux fois à 100 %, cela donne un recul unique. Ce jeu est devenu l'un de mes favoris, et voici pourquoi il est indispensable d'y jouer, expliqué de manière logique et fidèle au jeu.[/i]

[h2]🏙️ Night City : Un choc visuel et une ambiance folle[/h2]

La plus grande réussite du jeu, c'est sa ville. Ce n'est pas juste un décor, elle est vivante, sombre et fascinante.

[b]• Des quartiers avec une vraie identité :[/b] On passe sans transition des grandes avenues riches tenues par les corporations (les mégas-entreprises qui dirigent le monde) aux ruelles sales et dangereuses des bas-fonds. Chaque district a son propre style et sa propre criminalité.

[b]• La magie des néons la nuit :[/b] C'est quand le soleil se couche que le jeu devient incroyable. Les lumières artificielles sous la pluie et la sensation de gigantisme vertical (les gratte-ciels immenses qui vous écrasent) créent une atmosphère dystopique (un futur sombre et pessimiste) totale. On s'y perd avec un plaisir fou.

[h2]🎭 Une histoire comme au cinéma et des choix importants[/h2]

Le point fort du jeu, c'est son écriture et la façon dont la mise en scène nous implique directement au cœur du récit.

[b]• Une réalisation au plus près de l'action :[/b] Tout est fait pour qu'on ne décroche jamais de l'histoire. Les cinématiques et les discussions s'intègrent directement au jeu sans aucune coupure. Cela donne l'impression de vivre un film interactif très réaliste, où la tension des scènes violentes et l'intimité des moments calmes nous touchent de plein fouet.

[b]• Des choix qui changent votre parcours :[/b] Vos origines (Nomade, Gamin des rues ou Corpo) et vos décisions ouvrent différents embranchements. Vos choix modifient le déroulement des contrats, vos relations avec les personnages et même la conclusion de l'histoire principale. C'est ce qui donne envie de recommencer le jeu plusieurs fois.

[b]• La cohabitation avec le fantôme de Johnny Silverhand :[/b] Être bloqué dans sa propre tête avec le construct psychique (la conscience sauvegardée) de ce rockeur rebelle change complètement l'aventure. On a la sensation permanente de parler à un véritable fantôme qui hante vos pensées. Johnny est toujours là, invisible pour les autres, à vous observer. Il passe son temps à juger absolument tout ce que vous faites : vos alliances, vos contrats, vos réactions avec les autres personnages et vos choix moraux. Ce parasite cynique n'hésite jamais à donner son avis bien tranché, souvent provocateur, ce qui rend l'expérience incroyablement immersive et unique.

[h2]⚔️ Gameplay : De l'action rapide et une liberté totale[/h2]

Manette ou clavier en main, les combats sont nerveux, fluides et très amusants.

[b]• Des combats dynamiques :[/b] L'action est rapide, agressive et rythmée. Qu'on utilise des armes à feu ou qu'on se batte au corps à corps (comme au katana), les sensations sont excellentes et on ressent bien l'impact des coups.

[b]• Un arsenal géant :[/b] Il y a une variété d'armes incroyable. Entre les armes cinétiques classiques, les armes intelligentes dont les balles suivent les cibles et les armes iconiques uniques avec des pouvoirs spéciaux, chacun trouve sa façon de combattre.

[b]• Le Cyberware (les implants) :[/b] Vous pouvez modifier le corps de votre personnage chez un Charcudoc (chirurgien de rue) pour changer complètement votre style de jeu. Devenir un prédateur ultra-rapide capable de ralentir le temps avec le Sandevistan, ou devenir un Netrunner invisible capable de pirater le système nerveux des ennemis à distance, offre une liberté totale.

[h2]📝 Le Verdict[/h2]

Cyberpunk 2077 est l'histoire d'une rédemption (un retour au sommet après un échec) incroyable. C'est un voyage émotionnel fort, porté par un univers cohérent et un gameplay ultra-plaisant. Ne pas y jouer, c'est rater un monument du jeu vidéo moderne.

La ville vous attend, avec le choix ultime qui fera votre légende : [i]Une vie paisible ou une mort spectaculaire ?[/i]

Cyberpunk 2077 has come a long way and now feels like a genuinely great experience. After a rough launch, the game is much more stable and enjoyable, and it finally shows what it was meant to be.

Night City is easily one of the game’s biggest strengths. The city feels alive, dense, and full of style, and the cyberpunk atmosphere really hits. The main story is engaging, sometimes dark, sometimes emotional, and a lot of side quests are surprisingly well written, to the point where they really stick with you after you finish them.

The gameplay gives you a lot of freedom. You can focus on hacking, stealth, guns, or melee combat, and play the way you want. Character progression feels rewarding, and you really feel your character getting stronger and more efficient over time.

I played the game with mods, and honestly, it makes a huge difference. The graphics look even better, the city feels more immersive, and outfit mods add a lot of style and variety. Being able to fully customize your character and their look makes the whole experience even cooler. With mods, the game can look absolutely amazing.

From a technical point of view, the game is now in a very good state. The visuals are great, especially on a decent PC, the lighting looks fantastic, and the soundtrack fits Night City perfectly. The voice acting and sound design also do a great job at pulling you into the world.

Overall, Cyberpunk 2077 is absolutely worth playing now. I’d definitely recommend giving it a shot and diving into Night City.

I have waited long enough to make this review, and I mean Holy **** what a comeback. We are talking about a rushed mess with a disaster of a launch by one of gamings top studios, to what I can after over 800hrs logged between all copies I own (240 on steam alone at time of making this review) confidentally now say is one of the best RPG's of this Generation...

So let's look back quickly, year is 2020, Cyberpunk releases and it's just a horrid buggy mess. I mean to the point that Playstation pulled it from the PS4 store and refunded people, which as any playstation user can tell you, refunds can be hard to get from PSN. But instead of calling it a wash and moving on, CD Projekt RED hunkers down, radio silence, and they start to work. I'm talking patch after patch, fixing their game, shaping it into what into what it was meant to be, until it happened. UPDATE 2.0/Phantom Liberty releases, not simply just adding more content storywise and otherwise, that was not good enough, no, CDPR releases an entire overhaul of the game that not only improves the game, it changes the very way it plays, FOR THE BETTER! They fix the skill system, balance out overpowered builds, but in a way that with thought and work you can still be powerful but with the feel that no one is a perfect god like person, well at least without a little work.

Visual: Depends on you, I mean that in the best way, Night City is beautiful, and with the right specs it only gets more beautiful. This game is truly next gen and if you are into modding, you can get it looking hyper realistic where you start blurring game to IRL, all you need to do is hit up youtube and you'll see everything from realistic concrete to pores in the skin textures.

Sound: The Sounds of Night City do not disappoint, walking around the city, you will hear the chatter of the masses, horns of cars, the ads from the billboards that tower the city, right down to distant gunfire, or the hum of the neon lights, and speaking of guns, they sound loud, dangerous and deadly.

Gameplay: Gameplay is nice......depending on where you play it and your preference. PC is of course the place to play, either it be mouse/keyboard, or like myself a Xbox Series X controller. There is tons of content between the main story, side gigs, cyberpsycho gigs, NCPD Scanner gigs, random encounters, easter eggs, etc. as of Update 2.3 we have more customization with vehicles and I won't even add in Phantom Liberty whic adds more story, more side gigs and way more customization with new clothing, and new relic perks.

Price: As of early 2026, Cyberpunk 2077 goes on sale often, but honestly I would say its worth it's normal full price, my opinion, although do yourself a favour and buy the ultimate edition that comes with Phantom Liberty. Look Phantom Liberty is a diamond, don't rob yourself of that beautiful experience.

Once again got it as a gift from a good friend, but it was a plan to get it either case as it is an amazing game.
The review will be for both the base game and the Phantom liberty DLC, based on multiple playthroughs and exploring.

First of all I will mention my setup as for this game that is really important and it gives more prospective, processor i7-12700K, 32GB DDR5 @6000 CL30, nvidia 5060 TI 16GB, installed on a nvme drive. The game was run on 1440p with DLSS 4.5 forced with path tracing enabled and frame generation x3 for most runs.

[h3]Positives:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Well we have to start with the visuals, this game is extremely stunning with the visuals, on the first playthrough you will spend more time looking around than actually playing the game, it really dominates visually, especially with path tracing.
    [*]Attention to detail, you are going to notice it all over the place, especially small details that you would not expect.
    [*]The audio is the next thing that is also up there, and here the top place is for the prime example on how great it comes out when you get great voice actors, not to mention that the ingame radio has awesome songs, and the battle music really fits the whole atmosphere.
    [*]RPG elements are well made and balanced, you do get a bit overpowered but it fits the game lore perfectly.
    [*]Variety of weapons to use and there is something we haven't seen in other games, netrunning abilities, it adds a unique way of playing.
    [*]Map is big, with tons of things to do and explore, with many distinguish spots that look apart from each so you can feel that now you are in the different place.
    [*]A lot of vehicles to traverse the vast map, even though you have fast travel, you can use the auto driver feature to enjoy the scenery.
    [*]Many factions that are different in their looks, talk and way they react to you, each fixed in their own block with some overlaps.
    [*]And do not let me started with how many different unique characters you are going to meet in game, many are complex characters with twists.
    [*]Keanu Reeves - do I need to say more?!
    [*]Idris Elba - not as much bonding on the screen as Johnny, but he filled the role pretty good.
    [*]Story is great, it has all you need, ups, downs, twists, comedy, annoyances, rage, culminations, etc... it is nice that some choices do matter on the story.
    [*]You want to play guns blazing?! No one is stopping you, oh you prefer stealth, go ahead it is optimized for it, netrunning it more your thing?! Well you will be able to make some superb combos. I want to say, you can play any way you like there is no limit and the game is not hindering you if you do not play a meta build.
    [*]The game is extremely well optimized for fast pace movement and slow motion.
    [*]Multiple endings, each one being different and unique in it's nature, and the main thing that was a surprise, as I cannot recall the last game that had this, once you get to the ending you get to play a bit more afterwards to have that proper feeling that you reached the end.
    [*]I feel like this needs to be mentioned, as they are one of the proper good ones, the developers are CD project RED.
    [*]Modding!!! This is done pretty good, with full support on how to get into modding, so if you want to tinker around and learn to code a bit, it can be done, but it is easier to go on Nexus mods, and just download the ones that you like the most, more than 10000 mods available. ps You do need a an account there but it is free and fast to create.
    [*]There is a character creation, it has fairly good options to create unique looks.
    [*]Great option from the developers, you can enable mature filter and it will hide certain scenes and characters will have at least underwear, this is really good as without this you would not be able to stream on youtube for example many parts of the story for example. There is also an option to remove songs from the radio that are copyrighted.
    [*]Optimized for DLSS, FSR, XeSS, choose whichever based on which video card you have, you lose a bit of quality that you will not notice unless you are looking for it hard and in return you will gain a nice boost in fps ( depends from system to system and the ingame settings you are using ).
[/list] 

[h3]Negatives:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]It still has issues, none of these are game breaking in a sense that you cannot fix all of them by either restarting the game or reloading a save game. I did get 2 game crashes as there is still a memory leak issue, happens mostly if you teleport many many times in quick successions and once when I overdid it with forcing the mod to spawn more police. Sometimes your dashing will put you through the floor, sometimes kerenzikov will not work.
    [*]Have to mention this, there is a one big inconsistency with the story that bothers me, without spoiling it, you will figure it out once you replay it.
    [*]Many choices are there as props and have no impact, which is a failure in my opinion, you force me to react but I get nothing no matter what I do.
    [*]As mentioned above, attention to detail is always a double edged sword, if you add some things and then fail to make others that are expected to be working, not work... is jus disappointing.
    [*]Even though there is plenty of weapons to play with, it felt poorly optimized for this masterpiece, simple example once you find the one iconic that fits your play style that is the only thing you will use for, in some cases, 90% of the game. Weapon modding is also simplified, compared to how cyberware was done, this felt like -lets just add this as an option. Prime example - why give me a silencer for an AR or SMG, if you cannot use it as a stealth weapon, to hear it a bit less? To have a cooler sound when you shoot?
    [*]Takedowns could have been done better to add more variety.
    [*]You do get to create your own character, visually I mean, but it felt more of just being there as an option that leads nowhere as you do not get to see yourself at all, except at the endings.
    [*]This is a personal opinion based on very hard difficulty, but it is a bit biased as the playthroughs were consecutive, the fighting becomes boring because you do become too overpowered soon, especially if you explore around, it does fit the lore. I had to give myself additional tasks to make it interesting.
    [*]Some of the mods would be better if they were part of the game to begin with, once you add some of them you do not want to play it without them anymore. This is not a negative per say but more of a notice.
[/list] 

[h1]VERDICT 9/10[/h1]

Definitely a big [b]YES[/b]on this one, and by this one I mean both the main game and the phantom liberty, the DLC is a must, it not only adds to the levels and skills, but enriches the story on it's own, you do get a great storyception there that fits perfectly with the main game.

If you want a futuristic GTA like game with a great story and awesome characters, that lets you play however you like playing without punishing you for it, this is the game for you then. The story is rich and filled with everything you would like to see, if you were watching a movie, but here you play the main protagonist. This might be a spoiler but hopefully not a big one, for me personally, I liked that there is no happy end, that is a such a great curve ball from many other games, and it fits the whole futuristic grim dystopia.

Should you get this game if you cannot run ray tracing or path tracing?
-YES, you should, the game is visually stunning even without those enabled, and yes being able to run either adds more to the visuals, but it is not that you are missing chunks of the game.

If you need videos on how the game worked, looked, how the mods fit, look and work, you can check some of the videos on my profile, be warned for spoilers as they are part of playthroughs.

[h1] Эпоха [/h1]Скорее всего, после этой игры не захочется играть в другие игры ещё долгое время... Проходил игру множество раз, сначала на PS 4, потом GOG-версию, после этого решил приобрести в Steam. С момента последнего прохождения игра сильно изменилась, переработали боевую систему, добавили новые ветки скиллов, новые квесты, локации и транспорт. Особенно нравятся бои с Макс-Так. Игра оставляет сильное впечатление, особенно сюжетом, интереснейшими глубокими персонажами, история которых запоминается надолго и общей атмосферой. Музыкальное сопровождение к игре стоит отдельных похвал - практически все треки, так или иначе, погружают в гущу событий, происходящих на данный момент в игре. Красивые локации и пейзажи города тоже заслуживают отдельного внимания (я давно не делал столько скринов, как в этой игре). Боёвка, не скажу что самая простая (на ультра харде), вышла очень динамичной и адреналиновой, но сбалансированной - ты убиваешь за пару ударов или выстрелов, и тебя точно так же могут убить, особенно если играть от дробовиков, пистолетов и клинков, приправляя всё это Сандевистаном. Физика езды на транспорте неплохая, просто неплохая. Но сами автомобили очень красивые и, по-своему, колоритные. Особенно заметно внимание к несущественным деталям, что, по-моему, свидетельствует о том, что игру делали с любовью. К сожалению, баги в этой игре тоже есть, но они незначительные и порой смешные, геймплею они никак не мешают.

Что могу сказать.
Думаю ни для кого не будет новостью что судьба у игра не легкая.
Я покупал игру на консоль в день релиза. И хоть я не встречал критических багов, но недоработки были видны невооруженным глазом.
Тогда я забросил ее и после выхода Песьего города дал ей еще один шанс уже на ПК.
И это было правильным решением!!

Оптимизацию подтянули, переработали кучу механик и добавили новые, исправили баги и ошибки.
Короче говоря сделали конфетку.
Я прошел на все концовки, выбил все достижения, облазил кучу скрытых мест - это был кайф!
В плане боёвки и стрельбы не могу сказать что меня что-то сильно впечатлило.
Ближний бой и холодное оружия 90% времени я игнорировал, огнестрел хороший но не ВАУ.
Сражения были просто частью сюжета или вынужденной мерой. Взлом и игра преимущественно по стелсу мне были интереснее.
Если бы была возможность со всеми как то договориться или задавить чисто "авторитетом" - было бы намного круче, но думаю реализовать это в подобном мире очень не просто.

Сюжет прекрасный, твои действия и ответы правда на что-то влияют. Потому что концовок ни 2, ни 3, и даже ни 5, их 10!!!!!
Могу сказать что пройти точно стоит все. Мне больше всего зашли с автобусом и казино.
Можно прорываться сквозь толпы врагом с катаной/имплантами, можно устроить жесткую перестрелку, можно взламывать и скрываться от вражеских взглядов - и выбор тактики сильно меняет ощущение от прохождения. Больший кайф получат те, кто любит отыгрывать какой-то класс перса и придерживается своей тактики в любой ситуации.

Итог такой - если вы не боитесь долгих игр и готовы погружаться в мир, 100% надо брать и окунаться в этот мир.
И совет - поставьте мод на несколько имплантов, чтоб совмещать хакерскую деку вместе с сенди или чем то еще (но это немного нарушает баланс как мне кажется, хотя ГГ бегущего по краю был именно так напичкан). А про машины, оружие и графические моды смотрите уже по желанию и по возможностям вашего ПК. Я играл на 11400 и 3060ти с ФСР на ультра с лучами(без овердрайва), все было супер и по графике и по производительности.

Но этот мир...это что то невероятное. Исследовать его - сплошное удовольствие!
Ты просто залезаешь туда куда, как ты думаешь, никто и не предполагал что ты залезешь, а там сундук/посхалка/или еще что-то. 
Едешь по пустыне и видишь матрас, лег поспать, просыпаешь и видишь рядом записку что появившийся перед тобой биг-фут теперь твой. Топчешься по свалке, находишь сканером странный холодильник, а там тело нетраннера с историей как он умер и декой ведущей к небольшому квесту.  Катаешься по заброшенной промзоне, видишь крутую тачку в стиле Хуникорна в ангаре, рядом шкафчик с запиской и ключами.
Мир просто напичкан интересными вещами, это цепляет и разжигает желание проверить каждый уголок мира не в поисках лута, а ради историй и событий.

P.S. Дэвид Мартинез R.I.P. <\3

[h1][b]Мрачное будущее[/b][/h1]

Что ж, пришло время для моего обзора. Не знал как сформулировать мысль, ведь хочется рассказать про все сразу, но вот как это связать, тут пришлось подумать. 
Небольшое предисловие: обзор больше субъективный. По сути застал весь жизненный цикл киберпанка от релиза до актуальной версии. 

Игра происходит в альтернативном развитии нашей истории, а именно в 2077 году, в вымышленном городе Найт-Сити. Ведь какой еще город может подойти, как не город возможностей? Сам город отлично показывает саму суть жанра киберпанк, даже просто перемещаясь по городу. Этот контраст очень бросается в глаза. Нарратив, что корпораты является элитой понимаешь без слов. И этим игра погружает в себя очень сильно. Безнадега, отчаяние пронизывает улицы. Каждый выживает как может, ведь иначе город поглотит. На улицах также образовываются банды, регулирующие определенные территории, и имеющие терки между собой. Ну и технологический скачок в виде имплантов, которые уже стали обыденностью.

Я люблю иногда в играх просто ездить по городу или ходить осматривая локации, проникаясь атмосферой. И тут меня встретила неожиданность. А именно повтор нпс. И если вы задаетесь вопросом, а что не так? Ну подумаешь, иногда повторяются, игра все же. НО! Мне хватило меньше 30 секунд, чтобы увидеть 4 одинаковых персонажей в одном кадре. Это при максимальной плотности толпы. Насколько это бьет по атмосфере, ну, думаю, очевидно. И это не единичный случай. 
Сленг также отлично дополняет этот мир. Многие выражения выглядят инородно для нас, но для них - обыкновенная реальность. И это просто отлично работает на атмосферу. 
Также жители не совсем простые болванчики, они реагируют на действие игрока, хоть иногда странно. 

[b]Персонажи[/b]

Ви - наш главный герой, наемник, мечтающий стать легендой. Но что такое быть легендой и как ей стать? Вот это и предстоит узнать. А также и узнать цену, которою необходимо заплатить, чтобы осуществить задуманное. На пути мы повстречаем много персонажей. Каждый из них запоминается, они хорошо прописаны, у них есть характер. И правда, переживаешь за них, хочешь помочь или наоборот расстраиваешься из-за различных ситуаций. Даже мимолетные персонажи, настолько завораживают своей харизмой, что остаются в памяти до самого финала. Действительно верится, что такой город живой, что так персонажи могли бы реагировать и выглядит это очень органично. Что только стоит один Джонни Сильверхенд. Как происходит взаимодействие с ним, то, как именно мы узнаем его ближе, и, даже, становимся друзьями просто великолепно. Он не упустит возможности прокомментировать тот или иной сюжетный поворот или сделает колкий комментарий. Его взаимодействие с Ви одно из лучших, что есть в игре. А Вик, Мисти, Джуди, Эвелин, Панам, Керри и другие? Все они, опять же, ведут себя как живые люди, у которых полно своих проблем и переживаний. А внимание к деталям тут проявляется еще благодаря разным телефонным звонкам, сообщениям. Очень неожиданно и приятно было, когда персонажи звонят и проявляют обеспокоенность, хотят обсудить ситуацию, приободрить и так далее. Это действительно заставляет верить в то, что мир живой.		

[b]Сюжет[/b]

Сюжет в игре глубокий, довольно трагичный, не боящийся задавать вопросы, нам, игроку. Разработчикам удалось написать историю так, чтобы я искренне радовался или грустил. А концовки... да... Оставляют послевкусие. И у меня часто возникали противоречия, бывало задумывался о событиях. Весь пройденный путь падает тебе на плечи, тот груз, те решения, что ты пронес через всю игру действительно влияют на тебя. Многие сайдквесты не хуже основных, и как же они дополняют историю. Ну вот не хочется покидать этот город, этих персонажей. Хочется остаться тут подольше. Очень затягивает!

[b]Боевая система[/b] 

Под стать городу, твой стиль игры зависит от тебя. Не хочешь пачкать руки, а быть невероятным хакером? Прокачивай нетранерство. Хочешь быть неубиваемой машиной для убийств? Пожалуйста, различных оружий тут предостаточно, каждый найдет для себя что-то свое. Многие локации можно пройти различным способом. Иногда определенный стиль очень сильно упрощает выполнение того или иного квеста. Прокачка навыков выглядит в виде древа. Мне не понравилось в нем то, что даже после эндгейма нельзя полностью прокачаться. Хотя, возможно, это сделано чтобы у игроков была возможность создавать различные билды и не становится имбой. 
Импланты, мне кажется, нужно впихнуть сюда. Довольно большой простор для экспериментов. Они, все же, более вспомогательный характер имеют, но не стоит их недооценивать. Каждый из имплантов упрощает сражения, исследование и это позволяет еще детальнее строить свой билд. Тем не менее, в своих прохождениях я слишком быстро стал имбой. Мне кажется, так не должно быть.

[b]Транспорт[/b]

В игре довольно много машин, так что каждый найдет для себя свою "ласточку". Машины тут отличаются разной управляемостью и скоростью, что очевидно. Хотя некоторые экземпляры слишком странно поворачивают. Также дизайн некоторых довольно специфичный, но не выделяющийся из общей стилистики. Вот что точно хотел бы указать, так это неудобное расположение камеры во время езды от первого лица. Вот тут не знаю, чем разработчики смотрели, но ездить так мне очень неприятно. Тут пришлось ставить мод. 
Еще есть рабочая система метро. Реализовано все хорошо, хотя мне не хватило тут иммерсивности. Я имею в виду, тут сделано как-то чуть "по-игровому". Просто выбор станции, условно черный экран и ты в вагоне. Нет вот этого перемещения от станции в вагон. Хотя, возможно, я слишком многого хочу. 

[b]Техническая часть игры[/b]

Ну с релиза много воды уже много утекло, уже давно игра хорошо оптимизирована. Также добавлен режим трассировки пути. И это просто вау. Игра выглядит просто фантастически. Настолько невероятной графики, игрой света, реалистичных теней я не видел. Если вы играли без трассировки пути, обязательно попробуйте! Это того стоит, хоть и достаточно ресурсозатрнатная технология.
Баги в игре еще остались, но практически все незначительные. Правда один раз выпал за карту, но некритично т.к. практически сразу вылез. Повторно попасть под карту не удалось хех. А чуть не забыл, насчет миникарты. При выборе квеста, соответственно прокладывается путь, и он отображен на ней. НО ОН КРИВОЙ. Это правда может показаться смешным, но когда вы будете ехать на высокой скорости и будет развилка с двумя похожими поворотами, то есть вероятность, что пропустите нужный. И тут появляется другая проблема. Маршрут не всегда (вообще довольно часто у меня было) быстро перестраивается. Он упорно показывает, что мне нужно развернуться. Ну это выглядит странно.

[b]Итог[/b]

Для меня киберпанк одна из лучших игр, в которую я играл. Сюжет, атмосфера, графика, геймплей на высшем уровне. В каждой детали видно, что разработчики вложили душу в этот проект, они горели этим и хотели рассказать нам, игрокам, незабываемую историю. И, на мой взгляд, они справились с отличием. Даже после конца игры, остаются вопросы, тоска, чувство пустоты. И это действительно показатель качества. Вероятно, когда будет анонс второй части я предзакажу эту игру, хоть практически никогда такого не делаю. 
  
Но главный вопрос так и остается без ответа:

[i]"Что же ты выберешь: тихую жизнь или смерть в лучах славы?"[/i]

**Not Recommended: I waited six years for this game to work.**

I was a day-one buyer of Cyberpunk 2077. I was there for the launch, and I swear I encountered just about every bug that ended up documented online.

So I waited.

I saw what CD Projekt Red had done with The Witcher 3 over time, and I genuinely believed Cyberpunk would get the same treatment. I wanted to experience this game when it was finally ready, rather than ruin my first playthrough fighting through technical problems.

Six years later, I still can't play it.

For me, it's the infamous audio crackling/popping glitch. If you've searched for this problem, you already know the worst part: everyone seems to have a different "fix," which means there really isn't one.

I've changed audio refresh/sample rates. Updated and reinstalled drivers. Turned SFX down and completely off. Disabled spatial audio. Used Windows spatial audio. Tried Bluetooth headphones, wired headphones, laptop speakers, desktop speakers, and monitor speakers. I've verified the game files, uninstalled and reinstalled the entire game, restarted the computer, turned it off and back on, and done all the other obligatory troubleshooting steps. I've gone through forums, Reddit threads, videos, and troubleshooting guides.

Believe me, if you're about to suggest a fix, I've probably tried it.

And before someone points at my Steam playtime as proof that the game must have been playable, those hours are extremely misleading. A huge amount of that time was spent with the game running while I was trying to troubleshoot the problem, testing settings, restarting, loading back in, driving around to see if the crackling returned, and repeating the process. Yes, there were stretches where I actually got to play the game, but I'd estimate maybe 25% of my recorded hours were spent genuinely playing rather than trying to make the game work.

And that's what makes this so disappointing. I *want* to play Cyberpunk 2077. I bought it at launch, watched CDPR spend years rebuilding its reputation, watched the game receive major updates and an expansion, and deliberately waited to give it the experience I thought it deserved.

But I've never once been able to actually play through the game.

Six years of patches, updates, fixes, and second chances, and a game-breaking audio issue that has been reported by players for years still makes the game effectively unplayable for me.

So, for the final time, I'm uninstalling Cyberpunk 2077. At this point, I have to accept that I'm probably never going to finish what I genuinely wanted to be a superb game.

I'm sure Cyberpunk 2077 is a great game when it works. I genuinely wish I could have found out.

[h1]Cyberpunk 2077 & Phantom Liberty – Fast 1000 Stunden in Night City[/h1]

[b]Mein Fazit vorweg: Eines der besten Rollenspiele aller Zeiten.[/b]

[h2]Meine Spielzeit in Zahlen[/h2]
Ich habe Cyberpunk 2077 nicht einmal, sondern zweimal gekauft – und bereue keinen Cent. Über 500 Stunden habe ich zunächst in der GOG-Version verbracht, seit dem Release-Tag im Dezember 2020. Danach habe ich mir die [b]Ultimate Edition auf Steam[/b] noch einmal zugelegt und dort weitere [b]443 Stunden[/b] in Night City gelebt. Zusammengerechnet bin ich bei knapp 1000 Stunden – eine Zahl, die ich sonst bei keinem anderen Singleplayer-RPG auch nur annähernd erreicht habe.

[h2]Der Release: Für mich kein Desaster[/h2]
Viel wurde über den katastrophalen Start des Spiels geschrieben, besonders auf den Last-Gen-Konsolen. Meine Erfahrung war eine andere: Mein damaliger PC war offenbar leistungsstark genug, sodass ich bereits zum Release eine weitgehend problemfreie Erfahrung hatte. Die Atmosphäre von Night City, die Charaktere und die Geschichte haben mich von der ersten Stunde an gepackt – lange bevor Patch 2.0 und Phantom Liberty das Spiel endgültig rehabilitierten.

[h2]Der zweite Durchgang: Pathtracing, Mods und ein neuer PC[/h2]
Mit einem neuen Rechner habe ich das Spiel auf Steam quasi neu erlebt. Mit [b]Pathtracing[/b] und Grafikeinstellungen auf höchstem Niveau ist Cyberpunk 2077 auch heute noch ein technisches Schaufenster: die Neonreflexionen auf regennassem Asphalt, die Sonnenuntergänge über den Badlands, die Lichtstimmung in den engen Gassen von Dogtown – das erreicht kaum ein anderes Spiel. Ergänzt habe ich das Ganze mit [b]Mods von Nexus Mods über Vortex[/b], was dem Spiel in meinem zweiten Durchgang noch einmal frischen Wind verliehen hat. Die Mod-Community ist aktiv, vielfältig und hält das Spiel für Veteranen wie mich lebendig.

[h2]Phantom Liberty: Ein Agententhriller auf Höchstniveau[/h2]
Die Erweiterung setzt mitten in der Haupthandlung an und führt V in den abgeriegelten Stadtteil Dogtown. Der Auftrag: die abgestürzte Präsidentin der NUSA retten – an der Seite der Netrunnerin Songbird und des FIA-Agenten Solomon Reed, gesprochen von Idris Elba. Was folgt, ist ein dichter Spionagethriller mit gebrochenen Loyalitäten, moralischen Grauzonen und einigen der stärksten Missionen, die CD Projekt Red je entworfen hat. Zusammen mit dem kostenlosen Update 2.0 – das Perk-System, Cyberware, Polizei und Fahrzeugkämpfe komplett überarbeitet hat – fühlt sich Cyberpunk 2077 seitdem wie das Spiel an, das es immer sein wollte.

[h2]Mein einziger Wermutstropfen: Kein Happy End für V[/h2]
Hier muss ich ehrlich sein, und es ist ein rein subjektiver Punkt: Ich bin jemand, der Happy Ends braucht. Thriller und Dramen meide ich im Kino eher. Cyberpunk 2077 bietet – weder im Hauptspiel noch mit dem zusätzlichen Ende aus Phantom Liberty – einen wirklich positiven Ausgang für V. Jedes Ende ist bittersüß, manche sind schlichtweg tragisch. Die Geschichte hat mich deshalb mehr als einmal nah ans Wasser geführt, und ja, die eine oder andere Träne musste ich mir verdrücken. Dass ein Spiel das überhaupt schafft, spricht allerdings für seine erzählerische Qualität. Es ist eben Cyberpunk – das Genre handelt vom Preis, den Menschen in einer entmenschlichten Welt zahlen. Ich wünschte mir trotzdem, CDPR hätte V wenigstens eine Tür offen gelassen.

[h2]Was das Internet sagt[/h2]

# Análise: Cyberpunk 2077 (2020)

Eu joguei esse game lá na época do lançamento, no ano em que ele saiu, e joguei direto no Xbox One. Naquele tempo, o jogo ficou com bastante bug e sofreu muito no console antigo. Mas hoje, jogando no computador, é outra parada, um troço totalmente diferente. A CD Projekt Red arrumou demais o jogo e conseguiu reviver ele por completo. Hoje em dia, dá para dizer que ele bem dizer não tem defeitos. É um RPG muito f***, com uma história absurda, jogabilidade animal e que hoje está muito bem otimizado. É um jogo que, na minha opinião, compensa demais comprar mesmo que seja em preço cheio.

### 1. Uma Variedade Gigante no Combate de RPG

Poucos RPGs me pegam desse jeito por causa da liberdade. O combate dele é espetacular porque te dá possibilidade de coisa para caramba. Se você quiser ir na surdina de stealth, você consegue; se quiser meter o louco, ir de peito aberto e trocar tiro ou meter a porrada, dá também; e o sistema de hackear os inimigos e os cenários é f*** demais. Essa mistura de estilos deixa a gameplay sempre divertida e variada, dependendo de como você quer montar a sua build.

### 2. Narrativa F*** e Amizades que Impactam

A história principal e as missões secundárias são muito fodas. Por mais que a gente já saiba que o final tem apenas algumas alternativas específicas, as decisões que você toma durante a jornada realmente impactam no desenrolar das coisas. O ponto mais forte é a conexão que você cria com os personagens; depois de um tempo ali, a amizade que você faz com a galera e as companhias pelo mapa mudam a forma como você enxerga o mundo e o que você de fato vai ou não fazer. O elenco de apoio e o Johnny Silverhand carregam o enredo muito bem.

### 3. A Vida em Night City e os Carros

A ambientação dessa repaginada de um mundo cyber futurista é bem bacana e tem um impacto visual absurdo. No quesito de pilotagem, a direção dos veículos em si não é muito boa, a física dos carros derrapa um pouco, mas a variedade de modelos é excelente. E o interior dos carros é muito legal de você ver, cada veículo tem um painel futurista todo detalhado, cheio de telas e design único que dá uma imersão do caramba quando você joga em primeira pessoa.

### 4. O Custo-Benefício da Phantom Liberty

Além do jogo base ter renascido, a DLC dele (*Phantom Liberty*) é espetacular. Ela vira e mexe também está em promoção e dá um revival muito grande para o título, trazendo uma história de espionagem f***, um distrito totalmente novo e mecânicas que refinam ainda mais o que já era bom.

### Conclusão

*Cyberpunk 2077* saiu da lama do lançamento para se tornar um dos melhores e mais bonitos RPGs de ação da atualidade no PC. Ele entrega uma história emocionante, uma Night City viva e uma liberdade de gameplay que vicia. Seja no preço cheio pelo tanto de conteúdo que oferece, ou pegando o combo com a DLC em uma promoção, é um jogo que hoje em dia se tornou obrigatório no computador!

《赛博朋克2077》是一场用八年宣发泡沫和玩家信任堆砌起来的、至今仍未真正兑现承诺的世纪骗局。它在上世代主机上的表现堪称电子垃圾，PS4和Xbox One版帧数个位数、频繁崩溃、贴图加载失败，以至于索尼被迫将其从商店紧急下架。这不是什么“优化不佳”，这是根本不能正常游玩。PC版同样好不到哪里去，内存泄漏导致打开菜单越玩越卡，玩家被迫每十五分钟重启一次游戏才能继续。即便到了2.0版本之后，恶性Bug依然阴魂不散——黑客RAM倒转、叫车功能失效、潜行击杀莫名其妙强制进入战斗，这些都不是偶发故障，而是长期存在的系统性溃烂。CDPR用一次次补丁表演“救赎”，但救赎的前提是承认罪过，而他们至今仍在用“我们一直在改进”的话术逃避对首发灾难的实质性问责。

它的开放世界是一个精心粉刷的摄影棚，夜之城的美术设计越惊艳，越反衬出互动层面的贫瘠与虚假。批评者早已指出，它的开放世界“空洞得不行”，垂直探索等于零，可进入的建筑屈指可数，大部分大楼只是电梯固定通往某几层的摆设。公寓、饮食、超梦这些系统全部可有可无，和开放世界完全不搭边，本质上只是菜单里多按几下按钮的装饰品。支线任务“不是跑腿就是到一个地方打怪”，满地图的弱智委托占据了一半以上的游戏时间。所谓“夜之城”，不过是一张巨大的、好看的、不能真正与之互动的壁纸。

它的叙事结构存在根本性的自相矛盾，主线短到令人发指，不到二十小时就能通关，玩家刚打算在夜之城大展拳脚，游戏就告诉你可以去打结局了。杰克与V的“过命交情”全靠几段播片和几句台词硬凑，玩家还没和这个角色建立起任何真实的情感连接，他就死了，然后游戏指望你为此悲伤。与此同时，V被明确告知生命进入倒计时、意识正在被强尼·银手侵蚀，但玩家转头就可以去帮路人找丢失的猫、参加街头赛车、给艺人当保镖，这种叙事上的精神分裂让“亡命徒”的角色设定彻底沦为笑话。主线被压缩到极限的根本原因，是CDPR为了赶发售砍掉了大量本应构筑羁绊的剧情，把这些内容塞进了可捡拾的芯片文本里，然后用一个明星脸角色的出场挤占了主角成长的空间。

它的战斗手感是灾难级的，枪械射速失控、子弹瞬间打空，枪声软绵绵像在打气枪，敌人中弹的反馈几乎不存在，后坐力设计更是毫无逻辑可言。警察系统在首发时蠢到令人发笑——杀路人后警察直接在你身边刷新，开车跑了他们也不追，AI根本不会自主驾驶警车。2.0更新后警察变“聪明”了，结果是从一个极端滑向另一个极端：他们无处不在、什么事都要插一脚，玩家做任务时频繁被警察打断，社区怨声载道。2.0版本还以“平衡”为名粗暴削弱了黑客流等成熟玩法，武器词条系统被大改得面目全非，大量玩家发现曾经喜欢的战斗风格被强行阉割。这不是更新，这是对既有玩家群体的背叛。

《往日之影》被粉丝吹捧为“救赎之作”，但它本身就是一部自我矛盾的产品。DLC把本体中那个快意恩仇、可以单刷荒坂塔的V，塞进了一个精心设计的道德困境里，却不给玩家任何真正改变结局的手段，连破坏性的发泄都被剥夺了。叙事格调从本体的反叛狂欢变成了彻底的憋屈与无力，与本体建立的世界观和角色逻辑产生了严重冲突。新增的Relic技能树形同虚设，毫无可玩性，偷车任务环节重复、载具战斗折磨，DLC的画面风格甚至丧失了本体那种华丽的赛博朋克质感，退化成了一部普通的现实风格谍战剧。

这款游戏口碑回暖的背后，是一套高度成熟的粉丝自我催眠机制。说它Bug多就是“你配置不行”，说它开放世界空洞就是“你不懂赛博朋克氛围”，说它主线短就是“支线才是本体”，说它战斗手感差就是“你不会玩枪械流”。CDPR用一部高质量动画《边缘行者》转移了玩家的注意力，用2.0更新重新包装了同一个内核空虚的产品，然后粉丝们感恩戴德地宣布“它终于兑现了承诺”。不，它没有兑现承诺，它只是把承诺的底线从“不可能”降到了“勉强能玩”。一个花了八年时间和数亿美元宣发的游戏，最终的标准竟然变成了“Bug没多到玩不下去就算成功”，这本身就是对整个游戏行业质量标准的一次公开羞辱。赛博朋克2077的遗产不是它最终变成了什么，而是它证明了在足够大的宣发预算和足够宽容的粉丝群体面前，一款半成品可以走多远。

Visually the game is exceptionally good and the city has an amazing flair. The gameplay is decent. If this is what you are looking for, it is a great game.

But for me it is not the masterpiece that some people seem to see, because the story and the characters are mostly bland. I would go with a neutral rating, but as I personally think this is important for a Role Playing Game, [b]I focus my review soley on the story and characters[/b] and give it a negative rating. If this was a movie it would be one of those Marvel movies with amazing visuals, but you won't watch them for their plot.

Obviously, the following explanation contains mild spoilers.

[h3]The reason to hate Arasaka, the main story antagonist, is not communicated.[/h3]

You are doing jobs for other corpos, the government and violent gangs. Jackie, your best friend, is still associated with a local gang. There are enough reasons to hate the gangs or other corpos, because you see them do evil in side quests. But the game does not show you why you should hate Arasaka. From what you see, they seem to be the sheep amongst wolves. Meanwhile your character does not have a moral problem wearing cyberwear from Arasaka or other corps. This makes it hard to be hate Arasaka as a player and understand characters motivations.

[h3]There are too many characters without depth.[/h3]

98% of named characters you meet are nothing more than a one-line description from a tabletop RPG. 

Take Regina Jones for example. She is an ex media person with an eyepatch that made it her mission to help cyberpsychos. That's what you learn the first time you meet her and you won't learn anything else after doing 25 missions for her. 

Or Viktor Vektor, your local ripperdoc. The game wants to establish him as a caring father figure. He calls first after finishing the main story. But all I know of him is that he is a nice guy and a former boxer who lives in the neighborhood and calls me sometimes during main missions. 

It would have been better to have less characters with more depth instead. Notable exceptions are the 4 potential love interests and a car.

[h3]Suspending disbelief is hard at times.[/h3]

Johnny seems to know everything and explains the world to V eventhough he has been locked away for the last 50 years and can't see anything that V does not. Why is he so certain that NC is still the same as back in his time? Why should I trust him to give me an accurate view of the world? 50 years changed quite a lot in our timeline. 

Also 50 years after his death, Bartmoss' hacks are supposed to still be better than anything. Has technology not evolved? Has no corporation analysed his hacks and learned from them? 

I understand that most of this is fan service. But still it goes above credibility at times.

[h3]When taking certain decisions, the main story is hard to follow.[/h3]

Let me give two examples. 

First: When you do a job for the Voodoo Boys, you meet someone from Netwatch at the end. I had to search the internet what Netwatch and three other things were, because this was the first time it came up in the game and it seemed important. As in-character I had no reason to believe this guy I knocked him out early in our conversation. After that I went unconcious and woke up at a different spot. I had no clue why that happened, because the game did not give an explanation even later on. Had I heard the netwatch guy out, I would have understood what happened. But why does the game give an option to knock him out early, if this skips an important part of the main story? 

Second: I went for the secret ending first. When I had to make the final decision, I was lost. 50 hours in-game earlier someone explained what the plan there was, but I could not remember it. This felt unsatisfying, as the game ended and I had no clue what I just did. There are other endings, that give the same decision, but they give a wrap up before. But if you choose this path, you won't get it.

[h3]Decisions are irrelevant.[/h3]

Adding to the point above, the game gives options sometimes, that seem relevant, but have no relevance. It has been critisized often, but choosing your background changes the first hour of gameplay, but nothing beyond that. You can also directly decide if you trust Johnny or not in the last mission from the same savegame. How you acted towards him earlier in the game does not really matter. These design decisions by the developers have the consequences that many things have to be vague throughout the game. But this also makes it harder to relate for me as a player, because V and Johnny have to be everything and nothing at the same time.

I have the feeling it would have been better to be more railroaded in a way similar to RDR2, where you have less direct decisions, but your decisions throughout the game decide how your character develops and what ending you get. This might have led to a better story arc, where you feel your relation with Johnny improve over time if you trust him. But as it is, he feels like a pita the whole time and I never came to a point where I understood his intentions.

All in all, this game feels as if most of the story and character work was invested in Act 1, which is about 6 hours long. After that story telling and character design degrades.

I don’t care what anyone says — [b]Cyberpunk 2077[/b] has come a long way. What started as a rough launch is now one of the most immersive, emotional, and downright beautiful open-world RPGs out there.

Night City feels alive — not just visually, but emotionally. You can walk down a random street and get lost in the atmosphere. The lighting, the music, the voices in the background — everything feels deliberate.

[b]The writing and characters?[/b] Incredible. V and Johnny Silverhand have some of the best chemistry I’ve ever seen in a game. Every major quest feels handcrafted, and even the smaller side jobs carry real emotional weight.

The [b]Phantom Liberty[/b] expansion took it all to another level. Idris Elba’s performance is top-tier, and the spy-thriller tone fits perfectly with the world’s darker side.

The gunplay and combat feel tight and weighty now. Cars actually drive properly, cops react like they should, and performance on PC is smooth. CDPR really pulled it together — it’s not just “fixed,” it’s reborn.
